programme.title: Das Yoga-Magazin
programme.desc: Relax, meditate, find yourself and all of this in the home living room _ The "Yoga magazine" makes it possible. Competent and likeable yoga trainers show the best exercises to switch off. The show does not only report from the television studio. Often the programs are recorded in a very special location _ for example in Ibiza. / Entspannen, meditieren, zu sich selbst finden und das alles im heimischen Wohnzimmer _ das "Yoga-Magazin" macht es moglich. Kompetente und sympathische Yogatrainer zeigen die besten Übungen zum Abschalten. Die Sendung meldet sich ubrigens nicht nur aus dem Fernsehstudio. Oftmals werden die Sendungen in einer ganz besonderen Location aufgenommen _ zum Beispiel auf Ibiza.

programme.title: "We move Austria" school / "Wir bewegen Österreich" Schule
programme.desc: Der SpaSS an Sport und Bewegung steht bei WIR BEWEGEN ÖSTERREICH Schule im Vordergrund. Ziel der ORF-Initiative ist es, Schulerinnen und Schuler sowie Lehrerinnen und Lehrer auf digitalem Weg mit kurzen Bewegungseinheiten zu erreichen und diese damit taglich in den osterreichischen Klassenzimmern stattfinden zu lassen. Weder Turnsaal noch Sportbekleidung oder spezielle Gerate sind dafur notwendig. Als unkompliziertes, tagliches Bewegungsangebot fur das Klassenzimmer will WIR BEWEGEN ÖSTERREICH Schule fur mehr Bewegung und eine gesunde und ausgeglichene Lebensweise begeistern. Zum Start der Erweiterung der Initiative WIR BEWEGEN ÖSTERREICH auf den Schulbereich stehen 30 Folgen mit einer Dauer von jeweils sechs bis acht Minuten mit maSSgeschneiderten Übungen fur den Schulalltag im Klassenraum zur Verfugung. Im Fokus sind Kraftigung, Geschicklichkeit, Koordination und Entspannung, um den oft stressigen Schultag besser bewaltigen zu konnen. Die Bewegungseinheiten werden von der diplomierten Sportlehrerin Karin Augeneder prasentiert.

programme.title: Bruno Gala
programme.desc: The gala takes place for the 29th time in history. This year it will be won in the following categories: player of the season, player of the season, goalkeeper of the season, referee of the season, coach of the season, legionar of the legionar of the season, team of the season, women's team of the season, amateur team of the season, dream goal of the season. Ronivaldo is also awarded the goalkeeper crown by FC Blau-Weiss Linz. The Esterreich-Brazilian storm scored 14 goals. / Die Gala findet zum 29. Mal in der Geschichte statt. In diesem Jahr wird es in folgenden Kategorien gewahlt: Spieler der Saison, Spielerin der Saison, Tormann der Saison, Schiedsrichter der Saison, Trainer der Saison, Legionar der Saison, Legionarin der Saison, Mannschaft der Saison, Frauenmannschaft der Saison, Amateurmannschaft der Saison, Amateurspieler der Saison, Traumtor der Saison. Zudem wird Ronivaldo vom FC Blau-WeiSS Linz mit der Torjagerkrone ausgezeichnet. Der osterreichisch-brasilianische Sturmer erzielte 14 Tore.

programme.title: Sportstammtisch im Radio-Kulturhaus
programme.sub-title: "Extreme sport: Keep keeping, increasingly challenging, increasingly crazed" with R. Pariasek and Dr. Muscle / "Extremsport: immer weiter, immer herausfordernder, immer verruckter" mit R. Pariasek and Dr. Musalek
programme.desc: In a relaxed atmosphere, Rainer Pariasek and the well -known psychotherapist Michael Musalek, together with competent guest, discuss different areas from the world of sport, which are usually not in focus. It is not so much about victories and records, as is more about humans and psychological pressure to which competitive athletes are exposed to. / In lockerer Atmosphare diskutieren Rainer Pariasek und der bekannte Psychotherapeut Michael Musalek gemeinsam mit kompetenten Gasten unterschiedliche Bereiche aus der Welt des Sports, die sonst meist nicht im Fokus stehen. Dabei geht es nicht so sehr um Siege und Rekorde, als vielmehr um den Menschen und den psychologischen Druck, dem Leistungssportler ausgesetzt sind.

programme.title: Das Yoga-Magazin
programme.desc: Relax, meditate, find yourself and all of this in the home living room _ The "Yoga magazine" makes it possible. Competent and likeable yoga trainers show the best exercises to switch off. The show does not only report from the television studio. Often the programs are recorded in a very special location _ for example in Ibiza. / Entspannen, meditieren, zu sich selbst finden und das alles im heimischen Wohnzimmer _ das "Yoga-Magazin" macht es moglich. Kompetente und sympathische Yogatrainer zeigen die besten Übungen zum Abschalten. Die Sendung meldet sich ubrigens nicht nur aus dem Fernsehstudio. Oftmals werden die Sendungen in einer ganz besonderen Location aufgenommen _ zum Beispiel auf Ibiza.

programme.title: "We move Austria" school / "Wir bewegen Österreich" Schule
programme.desc: Der SpaSS an Sport und Bewegung steht bei WIR BEWEGEN ÖSTERREICH Schule im Vordergrund. Ziel der ORF-Initiative ist es, Schulerinnen und Schuler sowie Lehrerinnen und Lehrer auf digitalem Weg mit kurzen Bewegungseinheiten zu erreichen und diese damit taglich in den osterreichischen Klassenzimmern stattfinden zu lassen. Weder Turnsaal noch Sportbekleidung oder spezielle Gerate sind dafur notwendig. Als unkompliziertes, tagliches Bewegungsangebot fur das Klassenzimmer will WIR BEWEGEN ÖSTERREICH Schule fur mehr Bewegung und eine gesunde und ausgeglichene Lebensweise begeistern. Zum Start der Erweiterung der Initiative WIR BEWEGEN ÖSTERREICH auf den Schulbereich stehen 30 Folgen mit einer Dauer von jeweils sechs bis acht Minuten mit maSSgeschneiderten Übungen fur den Schulalltag im Klassenraum zur Verfugung. Im Fokus sind Kraftigung, Geschicklichkeit, Koordination und Entspannung, um den oft stressigen Schultag besser bewaltigen zu konnen. Die Bewegungseinheiten werden von der diplomierten Sportlehrerin Karin Augeneder prasentiert.

programme.title: Football - Wwin Liga BiH / Fudbal - WWin Liga BiH
programme.desc: Founded in 2000, the Premier League of Bosnia and Herzegovina is the highest rank of football competitions in BiH. With the entry of cubes from Republika Srpska, two years later, the league receives a format with 16 clubs in the two -round competition system. Today, 12 clubs compete in the league, which after 22 rounds are divided into the Champions League and League to stay. The first historic champion of BiH was Leotar from Trebinje. The club with the highest championship titles Zrinjski is from Mostar. The greatest European success is the placement of Željezničar in the UEFA semi -finals in 1984. / Osnovana 2000. godine Premijer liga Bosne i Hercegovine najviši je rang nogometnih natjecanja u BiH. Ulaskom kubova iz Republike Srpske dvije godine kasnije liga dobiva format sa 16 klubova u dvokružnom sistemu natjecanja. Danas se u ligi natječe 12 klubova koje se nakon 22 odigrana kola dijele na Ligu za prvaka i Ligu za ostanak. Prvi povijesni prvak BiH bio je Leotar iz Trebinja. Klub s najviše osvojenih naslova prvaka Zrinjski je iz Mostara. Najveći europski uspjeh plasman je Željezničara u polufinale kupa UEFA 1984. godine.

programme.title: Football - English League / Fudbal - Engleska liga
programme.desc: Every August 20 team begins hunting at the most respected trophy of English football. The English Premier in the format in which the game was founded in 1992. As a continuation of the English League founded back in 1888. The season lasts to May in the two-circular system where each team plays 38 games. The first winter of the championship is the most trophy English football club, Manchester United. Biti prvak Engleske je cilj kojem teži svaki igrač Premier lige.

With the entry of cubes from Republika Srpska, two years later, the league receives a format with 16 clubs in the two -round competition system. Today, 12 clubs compete in the league, which after 22 rounds are divided into the Champions League and League to stay. The first historic champion of BiH was Leotar from Trebinje. The club with the highest championship titles Zrinjski is from Mostar. The greatest European success is the placement of Željezničar in the UEFA semi -finals in 1984. / Osnovana 2000. godine Premijer liga Bosne i Hercegovine najviši je rang nogometnih natjecanja u BiH. Ulaskom kubova iz Republike Srpske dvije godine kasnije liga dobiva format sa 16 klubova u dvokružnom sistemu natjecanja. Danas se u ligi natječe 12 klubova koje se nakon 22 odigrana kola dijele na Ligu za prvaka i Ligu za ostanak. Prvi povijesni prvak BiH bio je Leotar iz Trebinja. Klub s najviše osvojenih naslova prvaka Zrinjski je iz Mostara. Najveći europski uspjeh plasman je Željezničara u polufinale kupa UEFA 1984. godine.

programme.title: Football - England 2. League / Fudbal - Engleska 2. liga

Hard, fast, solid, modest, visited and most importantly, special. The second league of English football has 24 teams in the fight for the world, entering the Premiership. / Negde izvan multimilionskih ugovora i blještavih svijetla medijske popularnosti smjestio se Championship, engleska liga kakva je nekada bila. Tvrda, brza, čvrsta, skromna, posjećena i ono najvažnije, posebna. Druga liga engleskog fudbala broji 24 ekipa u borbi za svijetim ciljem, ulaskom u Premiership.

programme.title: Football - English League / Fudbal - Engleska liga
programme.desc: Every August 20 team begins hunting at the most respected trophy of English football. The English Premier in the format in which the game was founded in 1992. As a continuation of the English League founded back in 1888. The season lasts to May in the two-circular system where each team plays 38 games. The first winter of the championship is the most trophy English football club, Manchester United. Being a champion of England is a goal that weighs every player of the Premier League. / Svakog avgusta 20 ekipa započinje lov na najcenjeniji trofej engleskog fudbala. Engleska Premier liga u formatu u kojem se danas igra osnovana je 1992. godine kao nastavak na Englesku ligu osnovanu davne 1888. Sezona traje do maja u dvokružnom sistemu gde svaka ekipa kroz sezonu odigra 38 utakmica. Prvi osvajač prvenstva je najtrofejniji engleski fudbalski klub, Mančester Junajted. Biti prvak Engleske je cilj kojem teži svaki igrač Premier lige.

programme.title: Football - Argentine League / Fudbal - Argentinska liga
programme.desc: The first country outside the United Kingdom established its football league is Argentina. It was ancivered in 1891. years and the right to play only teams from Buenos Ayres and Rosari. 1931. year when 18 clubs moved from amateur to professional ranking Argentine League, he received the forerunner of his present version. Since 2014. The League has 30 teams that fight the title of Argentina in a single round system. The highest title counts the legendary river salaries from Buenos Aires, but his biggest rival of Bok Juniors follows him. / Prva zemlja izvan Ujedinjenog Kraljevstva koja je uspostavila svoju fudbalsku ligu je Argentina. Bilo je to davne 1891. godine te su pravo nastupa imale samo ekipe iz Buenos Ajresa i Rosarija. 1931. godine kada 18 klubova prelazi iz amaterskog u profesionalni rang argentinska liga dobija preteču svoje današnje verzije. Od 2014. godine liga broji 30 ekipa koje se u jednokružnom sistemu bore za titulu prvaka Argentine. Najviše titula broji legendarni River Plate iz Buenos Ajresa ali ga u stopu prati i njegov najveći rival Boka Juniors.

Today, 12 clubs compete in the league, which after 22 rounds are divided into the Champions League and League to stay. The first historic champion of BiH was Leotar from Trebinje. The club with the highest championship titles Zrinjski is from Mostar. The greatest European success is the placement of Željezničar in the UEFA semi -finals in 1984. / Osnovana 2000. godine Premijer liga Bosne i Hercegovine najviši je rang nogometnih natjecanja u BiH. Ulaskom kubova iz Republike Srpske dvije godine kasnije liga dobiva format sa 16 klubova u dvokružnom sistemu natjecanja. Danas se u ligi natječe 12 klubova koje se nakon 22 odigrana kola dijele na Ligu za prvaka i Ligu za ostanak. Prvi povijesni prvak BiH bio je Leotar iz Trebinja. Klub s najviše osvojenih naslova prvaka Zrinjski je iz Mostara. Najveći europski uspjeh plasman je Željezničara u polufinale kupa UEFA 1984. godine.

programme.title: Basketball - Champions League / Košarka - Liga prvaka
programme.desc: One of the youngest continental competitions for basketball players in Europe is a new Fiba "Basketball Champions League". The aim of this league to compete with the organization "Euroleague Basketball S.L." And her Euroleague that includes the strongest European clubs. In this league clubs, they acquire the right to perform on the basis of placements in their own national championships while in the Euroleague of the rights, it is acquired on the basis of licenses. The competition system consists of two rounds of qualifications, regular part, playoffs and the final tournament of the best four or popularly called Final for. The finish is held at the end of April. / Jedno od najmlađih kontinentalnih takmičenja za košarkaše u Evropi je nova Fibina "Basketball Champions League". Cilj ove lige je konkurisati organizaciji "Euroleague Basketball S.L." i njenoj Evroligi koja obuhvata najjače evropske klubove. U ovakvoj ligi klubovi stiču pravo nastupa na temelju plasmana u vlastitim nacionalnim prvenstvima dok u Evroligi prava nastupa se stiče na temelju licenci. Sistem takmičenja se sastoji od dva kruga kvalifikacija, regularnog dela, plejofa i završnog turnira najbolje četvorice ili popularno zvani fajnal for. Završnica se održava krajem aprila meseca.

programme.title: FBBAL - Italian League / Fudbal - Italijanska liga
programme.desc: Italian series and is a professional football competition that counts 20 teams in the two-circular league championship. Since 1929, when she was founded, a series A became synonymous with tactical football. For many years, Italian football has considered the best in Europe with its quality and a series of great players and trainers. With the fall of the financial power of Italian first league and a series of corruption scandals, the league briefly fell in quality but is returned to the place where it belongs. / Italijanska Serija A profesionalno je fudbalsko takmičenje koje broji 20 momčadi u dvokružnom ligaškom prvenstvu. Još od 1929. godine kada je osnovana, Serija A je postala sinonim za taktički fudbal. Dugi niz godina italijanski se fudbal svojom kvalitetom te nizom sjajnih igrača i trenera smatrao najboljim u Evropi. Padom finansijske moći italijanskih prvoligaša te nizom korupcijskih skandala liga je nakratko pala u kvaliteti ali se sigurnim koracima vraća na mjesto gdje i pripada.

programme.title: Football - Romania League / Fudbal - Rumunjska liga
programme.desc: Romania's first football league has a long history, the first season has been played back in 1909. year when the first title won the extinguished Olympi Bucharest today. Throughout history, the undisputed rulers of this league are Steau and Dinamo from Bucharest who took most of the title of champions. The League currently has 14 clubs and after "regular" work, where everyone plays one game at home and one in the guests, the league is divided into two parts. The first part is play off for the champion where six best clubs are participated as the rest is struggling in a special part for survival. / Prva fudbalska liga Rumunije ima dugačku istoriju, prva sezona je odigrana davne 1909. godine kada je prvu titulu osvojila danas ugašena Olimpija Bukurešt. Kroz istoriju neprikosnoveni vladari ove lige su Steaua i Dinamo iz Bukurešta koji su uzeli većinu titula šampiona. Trenutno liga broji 14 klubova i nakon "regularnog" dela, gdje svako sa svakim igra po jednu utakmicu na domaćem terenu i jednu u gostima, liga se deli na dva dijela. Prvi dio je play off za šampiona gde učestvuje šest najbolje plasiranih klubova dok se ostatak bori u posebnom delu za opstanak.

Uz vrhunske ekipe špansku ligu krasi i izrazito tehnički mentalitet igre većine klubova sa ciljem za nadigravanjem protivnika.

programme.title: Basketball - ABA League / Košarka - ABA liga
programme.desc: The ABA League was established by the best basketball clubs from Bosnia and Herzegovina, Montenegro, Croatia, Serbia and Slovenia. As such consists of clubs from the space of the former SFRY and representatives of Hungary, Bulgaria, Israel and the Czech Republic were still involved in it. On several occasions, it has changed the name depending on the sponsor, and today is the official name "Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League". The competition is played in two parts, the first part takes place by playing two games, each with each, one on the domestic and one on the away field, ie by the two-circular league system. The second part of the competition or playoffs differed from the season by season. / ABA liga je osnovana od strane najboljih košarkaških klubova iz Bosne i Hercegovine, Crne Gore, Hrvatske, Srbije i Slovenije. Kao takva sastoji se od klubova sa prostora bivše SFRJ te su u njoj još učestvovali predstavnici Mađarske, Bugarske, Izraela i Češke. U nekoliko navrata je promjenila i naziv u zavisnosti od sponzora, a danas joj je službeni naziv "Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League". Takmičenje se igra u dva dijela, prvi dio se odvija tako što sve ekipe igraju po dvije utakmice, svako sa svakim, jednu na domaćem i jednu na gostujućem terenu, odnosno po dvokružnom liga sistemu. Drugi dio takmičenja odnosno plej-of se razlikovao od sezone do sezone.

programme.title: Basketball - ABA League / Košarka - ABA liga
programme.desc: The ABA League was established by the best basketball clubs from Bosnia and Herzegovina, Montenegro, Croatia, Serbia and Slovenia. As such consists of clubs from the space of the former SFRY and representatives of Hungary, Bulgaria, Israel and the Czech Republic were still involved in it. On several occasions, it has changed the name depending on the sponsor, and today is the official name "Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League". The competition is played in two parts, the first part takes place by playing two games, each with each, one on the domestic and one on the away field, ie by the two-circular league system. The second part of the competition or playoffs differed from the season by season. / ABA liga je osnovana od strane najboljih košarkaških klubova iz Bosne i Hercegovine, Crne Gore, Hrvatske, Srbije i Slovenije. Kao takva sastoji se od klubova sa prostora bivše SFRJ te su u njoj još učestvovali predstavnici Mađarske, Bugarske, Izraela i Češke. U nekoliko navrata je promjenila i naziv u zavisnosti od sponzora, a danas joj je službeni naziv "Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League". Takmičenje se igra u dva dijela, prvi dio se odvija tako što sve ekipe igraju po dvije utakmice, svako sa svakim, jednu na domaćem i jednu na gostujućem terenu, odnosno po dvokružnom liga sistemu. Drugi dio takmičenja odnosno plej-of se razlikovao od sezone do sezone.

programme.title: Basketball - VTB League / Košarka - VTB liga
programme.desc: The VTB league brings together the best basketball clubs from Eastern and Northern Europe. With the dominant Russian clubs in the league, clubs from Bijelarus, Estonia, Kazakh and Latvia are also attended. Through the history of the League launched in 2008. More clubs from Lithuania and Ukraine participated. Starting from the season 2013-204. The VTB League is also the national championship for Russian clubs, from which the champion of Russia becomes best. In order for clubs to access the league must have a minimum capacity hall for 3000 viewers. The name of the VTB league comes from the General Sponsor of the League of the VTB Bank. FIBA Europe is 2013 officially recognized the league. / VTB liga okuplja ponajbolje košarkaške klubove iz Istočne i Sjeverne Evrope. Uz dominantno ruske klubove u ligi prisustvuju još i klubovi iz Bijelorusije, Estonije, Kazahstana i Letonije. Kroz istoriju lige koja je pokrenuta 2008. godine sudjelovali su još klubovi iz Litvanije i Ukrajine. Počevši od sezone 2013.-2014. VTB liga je ujedno i nacionalno prvenstvo za ruske klubove, od kojih najbolje plasirani postaje prvak Rusije. Kako bi klubovi pristupili ligi moraju imati dvoranu minimalnog kapaciteta za 3000 gledaoca. Naziv VTB lige potiče od generalnog sponzora lige VTB banke. FIBA Evropa je 2013. službeno prepoznala ligu.

programme.desc: MLB or "Major League Baseball" is the highest rank of baseball league in North America. League beginners already before the end of the 19th century, in 1876. Kroz istoriju lige koja je pokrenuta 2008. godine sudjelovali su još klubovi iz Litvanije i Ukrajine. Počevši od sezone 2013.-2014. VTB liga je ujedno i nacionalno prvenstvo za ruske klubove, od kojih najbolje plasirani postaje prvak Rusije. Kako bi klubovi pristupili ligi moraju imati dvoranu minimalnog kapaciteta za 3000 gledaoca. Naziv VTB lige potiče od generalnog sponzora lige VTB banke. FIBA Evropa je 2013. službeno prepoznala ligu.

programme.title: Football - English League / Fudbal - Engleska liga
programme.desc: Every August 20 team begins hunting at the most respected trophy of English football. The English Premier in the format in which the game was founded in 1992. As a continuation of the English League founded back in 1888. The season lasts to May in the two-circular system where each team plays 38 games. The first winter of the championship is the most trophy English football club, Manchester United. Being a champion of England is a goal that weighs every player of the Premier League. / Svakog avgusta 20 ekipa započinje lov na najcenjeniji trofej engleskog fudbala. Engleska Premier liga u formatu u kojem se danas igra osnovana je 1992. godine kao nastavak na Englesku ligu osnovanu davne 1888. Sezona traje do maja u dvokružnom sistemu gde svaka ekipa kroz sezonu odigra 38 utakmica. Prvi osvajač prvenstva je najtrofejniji engleski fudbalski klub, Mančester Junajted. Biti prvak Engleske je cilj kojem teži svaki igrač Premier lige.

programme.title: Basketball - ABA League / Košarka - ABA liga
programme.desc: The ABA League was established by the best basketball clubs from Bosnia and Herzegovina, Montenegro, Croatia, Serbia and Slovenia. As such consists of clubs from the space of the former SFRY and representatives of Hungary, Bulgaria, Israel and the Czech Republic were still involved in it. On several occasions, it has changed the name depending on the sponsor, and today is the official name "Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League". The competition is played in two parts, the first part takes place by playing two games, each with each, one on the domestic and one on the away field, ie by the two-circular league system. The second part of the competition or playoffs differed from the season by season. / ABA liga je osnovana od strane najboljih košarkaških klubova iz Bosne i Hercegovine, Crne Gore, Hrvatske, Srbije i Slovenije. Kao takva sastoji se od klubova sa prostora bivše SFRJ te su u njoj još učestvovali predstavnici Mađarske, Bugarske, Izraela i Češke. U nekoliko navrata je promjenila i naziv u zavisnosti od sponzora, a danas joj je službeni naziv "Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League". Takmičenje se igra u dva dijela, prvi dio se odvija tako što sve ekipe igraju po dvije utakmice, svako sa svakim, jednu na domaćem i jednu na gostujućem terenu, odnosno po dvokružnom liga sistemu. Drugi dio takmičenja odnosno plej-of se razlikovao od sezone do sezone.

programme.title: Basketball - Turkish League / Košarka - Turska liga
programme.desc: The very beginnings of the Turkish basketball take far before the league of 1966. Years. Ear even early 20. The centuries of hoops under the hoops were known in Turkey. Students with Rober College in Istanbul in 1904. They first discovered the charms of this team sport. The first official competition of the best Turkish basketball clubs started the year after the founding of the league. The second league was launched three years later. Today's competition system consists of sixteen teams that plays each with every twice in the regular part after which the play-of eight of the best teams follows. The two weakest placed teams fall out of the first league. / Sami počeci turske košarke sežu daleko prije osnivanja lige 1966. godine. Još početkom 20. veka loptanje pod obručima je bilo poznato u Turskoj. Studenti sa Rober koledža u Istanbulu 1904. godine su prvi put otkrili čari ovog ekipnog sporta. Godinu nakon osnivanja lige započelo je i prvo službeno takmičenje najboljih turskih košarkaških klubova. Tri godine kasnije pokrenuta je i druga liga. Današnji sistem takmičenja se sastoji od šesnaest ekipa koja igra svaka sa svakim dva puta u regularnom delu nakon kojeg sledi plej-of osam najboljih ekipa. Iz prve lige ispadaju dve najslabije plasirane ekipe.

programme.title: Football: HNL / Fudbal: HNL
programme.desc: Croatian football league (HNL) was founded in 1992. year and the first historical title won Split Hajduk. Through years, the system of competition and the number of clubs changed but in recent years, today's system with 10 teams and the four-round form of the competition. The transition cup intended to champion is the work of the academic sculptor Marijana earns. He won him in Zagreb Dinamo mostly. / Hrvatska fudbalska liga (HNL) osnovana je 1992. godine i prvu istorijsku titulu je osvojio splitski Hajduk. Kroz godine sistem takmičenja i broj klubova se mijenjao ali poslednjih godina ustalio se današnji sistem sa 10 ekipa i četverokružnim oblikom takmičenja. Prijelazni kup namjenjen prvaku djelo je akademskog kipara Marijana Zaradića. Najviše puta osvajao ga je zagrebački Dinamo.

programme.title: Football - Superliga Serbia / Fudbal - Superliga Srbije
programme.desc: The Serbian Super League has had its premiere in the 2006/2007 season. In today's league system, there are 20 teams and functions on the two-circular principle of competition. The history of the Super League was largely marked by two large Belgrade Rivals, Partizan and Red Star. Historically, according to the number of titles, the red-white part of the city is more successful. / Srpska Superliga svoju premijeru imala je u sezoni 2006./2007. U današnjem sistemu liga broji 20 ekipa i funkcionira po dvokružnom principu takmičenja. Historiju Superlige u najvećoj su mjeri obilježila dva velika beogradska rivala, Partizan i Crvena zvezda. Historijski gledano, po broju osvojenih naslova crveno-bijeli dio grada je uspješniji.

The transition cup intended to champion is the work of the academic sculptor Marijana earns. He won him in Zagreb Dinamo mostly. / Hrvatska fudbalska liga (HNL) osnovana je 1992. godine i prvu istorijsku titulu je osvojio splitski Hajduk. Kroz godine sistem takmičenja i broj klubova se mijenjao ali poslednjih godina ustalio se današnji sistem sa 10 ekipa i četverokružnim oblikom takmičenja. Prijelazni kup namjenjen prvaku djelo je akademskog kipara Marijana Zaradića. Najviše puta osvajao ga je zagrebački Dinamo.

programme.title: Ice Hockey - KHL
programme.desc: The strongest hockey hockey competition in Europe and Asia is called KHL or a continental hockey league. Only the competition was created from the Russian Super League in 2008. And since then the competition is spreading to increasingly European and Asian countries and thus becomes an unofficial other the best hockey world of the world after the American-Canadian NLA. / Najjače hokejaško takmičenje u hokeju na području Evrope i Azije zove se KHL ili Kontinentalna Hokejaška Liga. Samo takmičenje je nastalo iz ruske Superlige 2008. godine i od tada se takmičenje širi na sve više evropskih i azijskih zemalja i tako postaje neslužbeno druga najbolja hokejaška liga svijeta nakon američko-kanadskog NHLa.

programme.title: Football - Superliga Serbia / Fudbal - Superliga Srbije
programme.desc: The Serbian Super League has had its premiere in the 2006/2007 season. In today's league system, there are 20 teams and functions on the two-circular principle of competition. The history of the Super League was largely marked by two large Belgrade Rivals, Partizan and Red Star. Historically, according to the number of titles, the red-white part of the city is more successful. / Srpska Superliga svoju premijeru imala je u sezoni 2006./2007. U današnjem sistemu liga broji 20 ekipa i funkcionira po dvokružnom principu takmičenja. Historiju Superlige u najvećoj su mjeri obilježila dva velika beogradska rivala, Partizan i Crvena zvezda. Historijski gledano, po broju osvojenih naslova crveno-bijeli dio grada je uspješniji.

Through years, the system of competition and the number of clubs changed but in recent years, today's system with 10 teams and the four-round form of the competition. The transition cup intended to champion is the work of the academic sculptor Marijana earns. He won him in Zagreb Dinamo mostly. / Hrvatska fudbalska liga (HNL) osnovana je 1992. godine i prvu istorijsku titulu je osvojio splitski Hajduk. Kroz godine sistem takmičenja i broj klubova se mijenjao ali poslednjih godina ustalio se današnji sistem sa 10 ekipa i četverokružnim oblikom takmičenja. Prijelazni kup namjenjen prvaku djelo je akademskog kipara Marijana Zaradića. Najviše puta osvajao ga je zagrebački Dinamo.

programme.title: Football - Superliga Serbia / Fudbal - Superliga Srbije
programme.desc: The Serbian Super League has had its premiere in the 2006/2007 season. In today's league system, there are 20 teams and functions on the two-circular principle of competition. The history of the Super League was largely marked by two large Belgrade Rivals, Partizan and Red Star. Historically, according to the number of titles, the red-white part of the city is more successful. / Srpska Superliga svoju premijeru imala je u sezoni 2006./2007. U današnjem sistemu liga broji 20 ekipa i funkcionira po dvokružnom principu takmičenja. Historiju Superlige u najvećoj su mjeri obilježila dva velika beogradska rivala, Partizan i Crvena zvezda. Historijski gledano, po broju osvojenih naslova crveno-bijeli dio grada je uspješniji.

programme.title: Semifinal: Italy x Brazil / Semifinal: Itália x Brasil
programme.desc: Worth a place in the final, Italy and Brazil duel at the stadium covered with Hua Mak in Bangkok, Thailand. programme.title: Third Place Dispute: Japao X Brasil / Disputa de Terceiro Lugar: Japao x Brasil
programme.desc: Worth the bronze, Japao and Brazil duel at the stadium covered with Hua Mak in Bangkok, Thailand. programme.title: Final: Türkiye x Italy / Final: Turquia x Itália
programme.desc: For the great decision, in a single game, Türkiye and Italy duel at the stadium covered with Hua Mak in Bangkok, Thailand. The Turkish play their first World Cup final, while the Italians, unbeaten for 35 matches, were champions in 2002 and vice in 2018. / Pela grande decisao, em jogo único, Turquia e Itália duelam no Estádio Coberto de Hua Mak, em Bangkok, Tailândia. As turcas disputam sua primeira final de Mundial, enquanto as italianas, invictas há 35 partidas, foram campeas em 2002 e vices em 2018.

programme.desc: Weekly television broadcast dedicated to Bulgarian tourism. The team travels all over Bulgaria and promotes Bulgarian cities as attractive tourist destinations. programme.desc: Represented by Morgan Freeman, the series "Through the Corridors of Time" explores the greatest mysteries of our existence - issues that puzzles humanity from all over eternity. Questions that have been reflected in the most sophisticated minds of the human race. Today, science has evolved to a stage where specific facts and evidence may provide us with answers, displacing philosophical theories. "Through the corridors of time" brings together brilliant thinkers and magnificent ideas from different fields of science - astrophysics, astrobiology, quantum mechanics, string theory, and others to reveal the amazing truth about our universe. / Представена от Морган Фрийман, поредицата "През коридорите на времето" изследва най-големите мистерии на съществуването ни - въпросите, озадачаващи човечеството от цяла вечност. Въпроси, върху които са размишлявали най-изтънчените умове на човешкия род. Днес науката се е развила до етап, при който конкретните факти и доказателства може би ще ни предоставят отговорите, измествайки философските теории. "През коридорите на времето" събира блестящи мислители и великолепни идеи от различни сфери на науката - астрофизиката, астробиологията, квантовата механика, струнната теория и други, за да ни разкрие удивителната истина за нашата Вселена.

programme.title: The latter wins / Последният печели
programme.desc: "The Last Win" is a fun-cognitive, family quiz show involving four players. It consists of three rounds with different spheres of knowledge, in which the questions are of different point value. After the end of each round, one participant drops out, and the winner wins the right to compete in the next episode and plays until someone else is able to beat him. / "Последният печели" е забавно-познавателно, семейно куиз шоу, в което участват четирима играчи. Състои се от три кръга с различни сфери на познанието, в които въпросите са с различна точкова стойност. След края на всеки кръг отпада по един участник, а победителят печели правото да се състезава и в следващия епизод и играе, докато някой друг не успее да го победи.

programme.title: UEFA European qualifications for the World Cup / УЕФА Европейски квалификации за световно първенство
In the rhythm of the city / В ритъма на града
programme.desc: The show brings together the most interesting of worldly life. Current topics from the world of show business, meetings with interesting young people, with followers on the nets will be awaited. We will hear the rhythm on the street, and Ai Jen Za will help the leader with Wirel news. / Предаването събира най-интересното от светския живот. Ще ви очакват актуални теми от света на шоубизнеса, срещи с интересни млади хора, с последователи в мрежите. Ще чуем ритъма на улицата, а AI Джен Зи ще помага на водещата с вайръл новините.

programme.title: You have a meeting with ... Diana Lyubenova / Имате среща с ... Диана Любенова
programme.desc: In the electricity show "You have a meeting ... with Diana Lyubenova" there will be celebrities from the world of art, culture, music, theater, journalism, sports and not only. All of them will reveal to Diana Lyubenova and public television viewers their dreams, they will share the path to success, the good and difficult times in their lives, the priceless friendships and the people they can always rely on. / В ток шоуто "Имате среща... с Диана Любенова" ще гостуват известни личности от света на изкуството, културата, музиката, театъра, журналистиката, спорта и не само. Всички те ще разкриват пред Диана Любенова и зрителите на обществената телевизия мечтите си, ще споделят за пътя към успеха, за хубавите и трудните моменти в живота си, за безценните приятелства и хората, на които винаги могат да разчитат.

programme.desc: UEFA Europa League Highlights - (Sport. Program) The second most prestigious club football competition in Europe has been officially under the auspices of UEFA since 1971. The unofficial predecessor of this competition was the Fair Cup, which was played from 1955 to 1971. Since that season, the competition has been officially called the UEFA Cup and is under this name until 2009 when it was renamed the UEFA League of Europe. During the years, the format has changed several times, and since the 2004/2005 season. A group competition was introduced after which elimination followed. Neslužbeni prethodnik ovog natjecanja bio je Kup velesajamskih gradova koji se igrao od 1955. do 1971. godine. Od te sezone natjecanje se službeno zove Kup Uefa i pod tim je nazivom sve do 2009. godine kada je preimenovano u Uefa Ligu Europe. Tokom godina format se nekoliko puta mijenjao, a od sezone 2004./2005. uvedeno je natjecanje po skupinama nakon kojeg slijede eliminacije. Sam trofej za pobjednika ovog natjecanja dizajniran je 1972. za finale Kupa Uefa od strane talijanskog umjetnika Bertonija i svake se godine dodjeljuje pobjedniku koji ga čuva godinu dana...

programme.title: Football - Europe League / Nogomet - Europa liga
programme.desc: UEFA Europa League Highlights - (Sport. Program) The second most prestigious club football competition in Europe has been officially under the auspices of UEFA since 1971. The unofficial predecessor of this competition was the Fair Cup, which was played from 1955 to 1971. Since that season, the competition has been officially called the UEFA Cup and is under this name until 2009 when it was renamed the UEFA League of Europe. During the years, the format has changed several times, and since the 2004/2005 season. A group competition was introduced after which elimination followed. The trophy for the winner of this competition was designed in 1972 for the UEFA Cup finals by Italian artist Bertoni and is awarded to the winner every year, which keeps him for a year ... / UEFA Europa League Highlights - (sport. program) Drugo najprestižnije klupsko nogometno natjecanje u Europi je službeno pod okriljem UEFA-e od 1971. godine. Neslužbeni prethodnik ovog natjecanja bio je Kup velesajamskih gradova koji se igrao od 1955. do 1971. godine. Od te sezone natjecanje se službeno zove Kup Uefa i pod tim je nazivom sve do 2009. godine kada je preimenovano u Uefa Ligu Europe. Tokom godina format se nekoliko puta mijenjao, a od sezone 2004./2005. uvedeno je natjecanje po skupinama nakon kojeg slijede eliminacije. Sam trofej za pobjednika ovog natjecanja dizajniran je 1972. za finale Kupa Uefa od strane talijanskog umjetnika Bertonija i svake se godine dodjeljuje pobjedniku koji ga čuva godinu dana...

programme.desc: UEFA Europa League Highlights - (Sport. Program) The second most prestigious club football competition in Europe has been officially under the auspices of UEFA since 1971. The unofficial predecessor of this competition was the Fair Cup, which was played from 1955 to 1971. During the years, the format has changed several times, and since the 2004/2005 season. A group competition was introduced after which elimination followed. The trophy for the winner of this competition was designed in 1972 for the UEFA Cup finals by Italian artist Bertoni and is awarded to the winner every year, which keeps him for a year ... / UEFA Europa League Highlights - (sport. program) Drugo najprestižnije klupsko nogometno natjecanje u Europi je službeno pod okriljem UEFA-e od 1971. godine. Neslužbeni prethodnik ovog natjecanja bio je Kup velesajamskih gradova koji se igrao od 1955. do 1971. godine. Od te sezone natjecanje se službeno zove Kup Uefa i pod tim je nazivom sve do 2009. godine kada je preimenovano u Uefa Ligu Europe. Tokom godina format se nekoliko puta mijenjao, a od sezone 2004./2005. uvedeno je natjecanje po skupinama nakon kojeg slijede eliminacije. Sam trofej za pobjednika ovog natjecanja dizajniran je 1972. za finale Kupa Uefa od strane talijanskog umjetnika Bertonija i svake se godine dodjeljuje pobjedniku koji ga čuva godinu dana...

programme.title: Football - Europe League / Nogomet - Europa liga
programme.desc: UEFA Europa League Highlights - (Sport. Program) The second most prestigious club football competition in Europe has been officially under the auspices of UEFA since 1971. The unofficial predecessor of this competition was the Fair Cup, which was played from 1955 to 1971. Since that season, the competition has been officially called the UEFA Cup and is under this name until 2009 when it was renamed the UEFA League of Europe. During the years, the format has changed several times, and since the 2004/2005 season. A group competition was introduced after which elimination followed. The trophy for the winner of this competition was designed in 1972 for the UEFA Cup finals by Italian artist Bertoni and is awarded to the winner every year, which keeps him for a year ... / UEFA Europa League Highlights - (sport. program) Drugo najprestižnije klupsko nogometno natjecanje u Europi je službeno pod okriljem UEFA-e od 1971. godine. Neslužbeni prethodnik ovog natjecanja bio je Kup velesajamskih gradova koji se igrao od 1955. do 1971. godine. Od te sezone natjecanje se službeno zove Kup Uefa i pod tim je nazivom sve do 2009. godine kada je preimenovano u Uefa Ligu Europe. Tokom godina format se nekoliko puta mijenjao, a od sezone 2004./2005. uvedeno je natjecanje po skupinama nakon kojeg slijede eliminacije. Sam trofej za pobjednika ovog natjecanja dizajniran je 1972. za finale Kupa Uefa od strane talijanskog umjetnika Bertonija i svake se godine dodjeljuje pobjedniku koji ga čuva godinu dana...

programme.title: Football - Europe League / Nogomet - Europa liga
programme.desc: UEFA Europa League Highlights - (Sport. Program) The second most prestigious club football competition in Europe has been officially under the auspices of UEFA since 1971. The unofficial predecessor of this competition was the Fair Cup, which was played from 1955 to 1971. Since that season, the competition has been officially called the UEFA Cup and is under this name until 2009 when it was renamed the UEFA League of Europe. During the years, the format has changed several times, and since the 2004/2005 season. A group competition was introduced after which elimination followed. The trophy for the winner of this competition was designed in 1972 for the UEFA Cup finals by Italian artist Bertoni and is awarded to the winner every year, which keeps him for a year ... / UEFA Europa League Highlights - (sport. program) Drugo najprestižnije klupsko nogometno natjecanje u Europi je službeno pod okriljem UEFA-e od 1971. godine. Neslužbeni prethodnik ovog natjecanja bio je Kup velesajamskih gradova koji se igrao od 1955. do 1971. godine. Od te sezone natjecanje se službeno zove Kup Uefa i pod tim je nazivom sve do 2009. godine kada je preimenovano u Uefa Ligu Europe. Tokom godina format se nekoliko puta mijenjao, a od sezone 2004./2005. uvedeno je natjecanje po skupinama nakon kojeg slijede eliminacije. Sam trofej za pobjednika ovog natjecanja dizajniran je 1972. za finale Kupa Uefa od strane talijanskog umjetnika Bertonija i svake se godine dodjeljuje pobjedniku koji ga čuva godinu dana...

programme.sub-title: This is how your brain exchanges you - clever tips for better decisions / So tauscht Dich Dein Gehirn - clevere Tipps fur bessere Entscheidungen
programme.desc: Our brain is exchanging ourselves: For example, we humans feel friendlier when we hold a warm cup in our hands. programme.title: Voice of democracy: the pianist Lgor Levit / Stimme der Demokratie: Der Pianist lgor Levit
programme.desc: Igor Levit is not just a worldwide celebrated pianist and artist. He has been campaigning against anti -Semitism and democracy for many years. In 2020 he even received the Federal Cross of Merit in 2020. He gave house concerts during the Corona period and played for environmental activists, but after the terrorist attack of Hamas on Israel on October 7, 2023, he lost the basic confidence in German society. He criticizes the lack of solidarity with Judic people and the massively increased anti -Semitism. Igor Levit put this into a crisis. The hatred of Jews is not only a threat to himself, but for the livelihood of this Federal Republic, he says: "From now on my life is different from now on. And the examination of my own Judic identity is also different from now on. Where and what it goes before I negotiate with me." Levit has become more thoughtful, is looking for what he is looking Democracy drives what he can do and liked. And how he positions himself as a Jewish person in society. The film accompanies Igor Levit in this search: in the conversation in Blaibach, Bavarian with Michel Friedmann on the subject of "love", with dangers such as the Judian author Laura Cazes or Federal Minister Karin Prien. A search for his Jewish identity and for what makes democracy. / Igor Levit ist nicht nur ein weltweit gefeierter Pianist und Kunstler. Seit vielen Jahren schon setzt er sich gegen Antisemitismus und fur die Demokratie ein. Dafur erhielt er 2020 sogar das Bundesverdienstkreuz. Er gab wahrend der Corona-Zeit Hauskonzerte und spielte fur Umweltaktivisten.Doch nach dem Terrorangriff der Hamas auf Israel am 7. Oktober 2023 hat er das Grundvertrauen in die deutsche Gesellschaft verloren. Er kritisiert die fehlende Solidaritat mit judischen Menschen und den massiv angestiegenen Antisemitismus. Das hat Igor Levit in eine Krise gesturzt. Dabei sei der Hass auf Juden nicht nur eine Bedrohung fur ihn selbst, sondern fur die Existenzgrundlage dieser Bundesrepublik, sagt er: "Mein Leben ist ab jetzt ein anderes, als es vorher war. Und auch die Auseinandersetzung mit meiner eigenen judischen Identitat ist ab jetzt eine andere, als sie vorher war. Wohin und zu was das fuhrt, verhandle ich noch mit mir."Levit ist nachdenklicher geworden, ist auf der Suche nach dem, was ihn als Burger in der Demokratie antreibt, was er bewirken kann und mochte. Und wie er sich selbst als judischer Mensch in der Gesellschaft positioniert.Der Film begleitet Igor Levit auf dieser Suche: im Gesprach im bayerischen Blaibach mit Michel Friedmann zum Thema "Liebe", mit Weggefahrten wie der judischen Autorin Laura Cazes oder der Bundesministerin Karin Prien. Eine Suche nach seiner judischen Identitat und nach dem, was Demokratie ausmacht.

And as soon as the two have changed a few sentences, the first assignment is made: when an old man's apartment, his daughter discovered human remains. In the further course, the two of them still come across a victim who at first glance does not fit into the pattern of the serial murder, but could give the case a new cruel turn. / Mit einer Umzugskiste in den Handen fahrt Hauptkommissar Hamza Kulina (Edin Hasanovic) in den Keller des Polizeiprasidiums und betritt seinen neuen Arbeitsplatz: die "Abteilung fur Altfalle". Maryam Azadi (Melika Foroutan), Leiterin und einzige Mitarbeiterin der Abteilung, ist freundlich, aber auch ein wenig distanziert: Sie erwartet nicht, dass es der neue Kollege sonderlich lange bei den Altfallen aushalt. Und kaum haben die beiden ein paar Satze gewechselt, kommt es zum ersten Einsatz: Bei der Wohnungsauflosung eines alten Mannes wurden von seiner Tochter menschliche Überreste entdeckt. Schnell stellen Maryam und Hamza fest, dass der Mord schon einige Jahre zuruckliegt - und dass die Handschrift des Taters an andere ungeloste Mordfalle erinnert. Die Hinweise fuhren die beiden zu einem beruchtigten Serienmorder, der ein nahezu perfektes Doppelleben gefuhrt zu haben scheint. Doch als die Medien von dem Fund der Leichenteile erfahren und mit ihrer Berichterstattung die Ermittlung gefahrden, geraten die beiden unter Druck, die Opfer schnellstmoglich zu identifizieren. Ein Wettlauf gegen die Zeit und eine Reise in die Vergangenheit Frankfurts beginnt. Maryam und Hamza bleiben drei Tage, um Kriminalakten bis in die 1970er Jahre durchzuarbeiten und trauernden Angehorigen endlich Gewissheit zu geben. Im weiteren Verlauf stoSSen die beiden noch auf ein Opfer, das auf den ersten Blick zwar nicht in das Muster des Serienmorders passt, aber dem Fall eine neue grausame Wendung geben konnte.

programme.desc: Pain is omnipresent - and its supposed relief too. In Germany, pain relievers are sold over a hundred million packs every year. Tendency rising. Because of her arthrosis, she received seven times the recommended high -level dose of opioids from her house doctor, weighed only 45 kilos and suffered from hallucinations. Hirschhausen accompanies her in her withdrawal clinic. The power of the body: How we relieve pain itself can be able to gain new perspectives on how patients with multimodal pain therapy gain new perspectives. And the doctor and science journalist wants to know: At the University Hospital Hamburg, Hirschhausen goes to the limit for science - and tests on his own body how well the human pain defense system works. Prof. Christian Buchel, one of Germany's fusing neuroscientists, explains: "Pain is an indispensable warning signal: Attention, something breaks here! But with chronic pain, this actually good alarm system gets out of hand, another neurons and functions in the brain." A solution? Movement instead of protection. Those who understand pain can learn to deal with them better. Eckart von Hirschhausen shows ways out of the pain that do not rely on medication. By learning new movement patterns, through social contacts and conscious lifestyle, pain mechanisms in the brain can be influenced positively even after years of permanent pain. "Pain relievers are a blessing. And sometimes a curse. I was very impressed by how many levels have pain. And how many patients with chronic pain is withheld from the best treatment," says Hirschhausen. "A lot of what I learned in my studies 30 years ago is long refuted. And if I have the next time I have jerk, I don't take a tablet, but for the sneakers!" / Schmerz ist allgegenwartig - und seine vermeintliche Linderung auch. programme.title: WaPo Bodensee
programme.desc: The slightly injured and confused older gentleman, whom the Wapo Lake Constance saves from the water, proves to be an important witness in a murder case. Der Maler Carl Glanzer treibt leblos neben einer Segelyacht, die ihm der Werftbesitzer Weyrich angeblich vor einer Woche im Tausch gegen ein Bild uberlassen hat. Mechthild macht gleich groSSe Augen, als ihre Tochter Nele unbedacht beim Abendessen den Namen nennt. Denn Zielke war einst ein weltberuhmter Fotograf, der auch Mechthild in ihrer Jugend fotografiert hat. Niklas mochte gerne die Schwarz-WeiSS-Bilder aus Omas Vergangenheit sehen. Die Ermittler haben wahrenddessen noch keine heiSSe Spur. Dass er etwas verschweigt, spurt Julia genau. Als Zielkes Haus Ziel eines Einbruchsversuchs wird, muss sich Jakob bei ihm einquartieren. Paul macht bei der Untersuchung der Bilder im Atelier des Kunstlers eine uberraschende Entdeckung, die alle in Aufregung versetzt. Denn auch Mechthild hat den Kontakt zu Zielke wieder aufgenommen und schwebt nun in Lebensgefahr.

programme.title: Knowledge before eight - nature / Wissen vor acht - Natur
programme.desc: In this episode there is music, not for us humans, but for our pets. programme.title: The Savior - we are a lawyer / Die Heiland - Wir sind Anwalt
programme.desc: The propSite Heiko Podolke (Wanja Mues) is accused of realizations. Michaela Tampke (Kirsten Block), the leading actress of a feature film, collapsed on a folding chair during filming in the Babelsberg studio, and Heiko is held responsible for this. The expensive film production stands still, every day causes high costs. Michaela Tampke is not just the main actress: the film to which she wrote the script she recedes her life story as an actress in the GDR of the 80s. For many years, Michaela has been looking for a film production company that was able to finance and produce this film - its life dream -; In the film team in Babelsberg, you still know some from GDR times. But the folding chair itself also has a past. It is a GDR design, whose author Heiko Podolke himself is, who, however, stood out to secure his sample rights to the design. It turns out that the chair was manipulated. Who from the film team wanted to harm Michaela Tampke? Or has Heiko Podolke hung up the chair himself? Chief Prosecutor Tummler does not investigate the preload of the money washing against Romy alone, he has a vulnerable support from a young colleague. Veronica Strauss (Anne Muller) does everything possible to prove Romy errors. The fact that Romy is supposed to have a young half sister raises questions. Who is Serafina? Should Romy really believe her? What did your parents not help you? Romy's life so far has been used to be used in its foundations. / Dem Requisiteur Heiko Podolke (Wanja Mues) wird Fahrlassigkeit vorgeworfen. Michaela Tampke (Kirsten Block), die Hauptdarstellerin eines Spielfilms, ist wahrend Dreharbeiten im Studio Babelsberg auf einem Klappstuhl zusammengebrochen, und Heiko wird dafur verantwortlich gemacht. Die teure Filmproduktion steht still, jeder Tag verursacht hohe Kosten. Michaela Tampke ist nicht nur die Hauptdarstellerin: Der Film, zu dem sie selbst das Drehbuch geschrieben hat, erzahlt ihre Lebensgeschichte als Schauspielerin in der DDR der 80er Jahre. Viele Jahre hat Michaela eine Filmproduktionsfirma gesucht, die diesen Film - ihren Lebenstraum - finanzieren und produzieren konnte; im Filmteam in Babelsberg kennen sie einige noch aus DDR-Zeiten. Aber auch der Klappstuhl selbst hat eine Vergangenheit. Es handelt sich um ein DDR-Design, dessen Urheber Heiko Podolke selbst ist, der es jedoch versaumte, seine Musterrechte an dem Design zu sichern.Es stellt sich heraus, dass der Stuhl manipuliert wurde. Wer aus dem Filmteam wollte Michaela Tampke schaden? Oder hat Heiko Podolke selbst den Stuhl angesagt?Oberstaatsanwalt Tummler ermittelt nicht allein zu den Vorwurfen der Geldwasche gegen Romy, er hat tatkraftige Unterstutzung durch eine junge Kollegin. Veronica Strauss (Anne Muller) setzt alles daran, Romy Fehler nachzuweisen.Die Tatsache, dass Romy eine jungere Halbschwester haben soll, wirft Fragen auf. Wer ist Serafina? Soll Romy ihr wirklich glauben? Was haben ihr ihre Eltern nicht erzahlt? Romys bisheriges Leben wird in seinen Grundfesten erschuttert.

programme.title: Mister Paper
programme.desc: In a world of paper and cardboard, the headstrong Mister Paper lives a cheerful life with his cat. Equipped with scissors and glue, he tackles his surroundings as he needs. programme.title: A Habsburg on Mallorca - Ludwig Salvator and the magic of the sea / Ein Habsburger auf Mallorca - Ludwig Salvator und der Zauber des Meeres
programme.desc: Ludwig Salvator, Archduke of Austria and Prince of Tuscany, traveled and researched the Mediterranean with his sailing yacht for decades and finally settled in Mallorca.* His special interest was the research of unknown islands at the time, from the country and people, flora and fauna. He documented his trips in words and pictures. Magnificent Bucher testify to his universal work.*Archduke Ludwig Salvator von Habsburg-Lorraine and Bourbon (4.8.1847-12.10.1915) was an unpleasant, a universal genius, an dropout and nature conservationist from the very beginning. However, he was not only a fun -loving globetrotter, but also a recognized researcher of the Mediterranean, especially the Balearic Islands. He has recorded his research results on history, flora and fauna in extensive publications. The documentation shows the most important life stations of Ludwig Salvator and the sustainable effects of his research activity in the late 19th century. Throughout his life, he was driven by the desire to travel, understand and preserve. As the owner of the steam yacht "mermaid" and the "capitan spatent of the long journey", he was in the Mediterranean for decades to awaken the interest of the public for the regions that were largely unknown at the time, such as the Liparic Islands and the Ionian protective of the Balearic and the loveliness of their inhabitants particularly impressed the archduke. He created a small paradise in the northwest of Mallorca, where no animal was tired and no tree was allowed to be. For his monumental work "The Balearic Islands. Described in word and picture" he received the gold medal at the Paris World Exhibition in 1889.Annatuigent legends and anecdotes rose around the "uncrowned king of the Balearic Islands". He neither grief about the appearance that was expected by a member of the Habsburg family, nor about what others thought about him. Because of his scraping clothes, he was kept for a shepherd or farm worker - to his great amusement. He commented calmly that he was considered a scholarly nerd at Hof: "Better diverse than simple". Ludwig Salvator's love life was turbulent. The bachelor is said to have been to both sexes and have had countless affarities. He supposedly took care of his illegitimate children. One of his love affairs, Catalina Homar, the daughter of a carpenter, let the Archduke give an excellent training and finally made them the administrator of his vineyard. Ludwig Salvator was a scientist, artist, visionary, pacifist, nature conservation, writer and one of the most dazzling people from Habsburg. / Ludwig Salvator, Erzherzog von Österreich und Prinz von Toskana, bereiste und erforschte jahrzehntelang mit seiner Segelyacht "Nixe" das Mittelmeer und lieSS sich schlieSSlich auf Mallorca nieder.*Er war gebildet, unangepasst und aufgeschlossen. Sein besonderes Interesse galt der Erforschung damals unbekannter Inseln, von Land und Leuten, Flora und Fauna. Seine Reisen dokumentierte er in Wort und Bild. Prachtvolle Bucher bezeugen sein universelles Schaffen.*Erzherzog Ludwig Salvator von Habsburg-Lothringen und Bourbon (4.8.1847-12.10.1915) war ein Unangepasster, ein Universalgenie, ein Aussteiger und Natur-schutzer der ersten Stunde. Er war aber nicht nur ein lebenslustiger Globetrotter, sondern auch ein anerkannter Forscher des Mittelmeerraumes, besonders der Balearen. Seine Forschungsergebnisse uber Geschichte, Tier- und Pflanzenwelt hat er in umfangreichen Publikationen festgehalten.Die Dokumentation zeigt die wichtigsten Lebensstationen Ludwig Salvators und die nachhaltigen Auswirkungen seiner Forschertatigkeit im ausgehenden 19. Jahrhundert. Zeit seines Lebens war er getrieben von dem Verlangen zu reisen, zu verstehen und zu bewahren. Als Besitzer der Dampfsegelyacht "Nixe" und des "Kapitanspatentes der langen Fahrt" war er jahrzehntelang im Mittelmeer unterwegs, um das Interesse der Öffentlichkeit fur damals weitgehend unbekannte Regionen zu wecken, wie die Liparischen Inseln und die Ionischen Inseln.Die wilde Schonheit der Balearen und die Liebenswurdigkeit von deren Bewohnern beeindruckten den Erzherzog besonders. Er schuf sich im Nordwesten Mallorcas ein kleines Paradies, wo kein Tier getotet und kein Baum gefallt werden durfte. Fur sein Monumentalwerk "Die Balearen. Geschildert in Wort und Bild" erhielt er auf der Pariser Weltausstellung 1889 die Goldmedaille.Unzahlige Legenden und Anekdoten ranken sich um den "ungekronten Konig der Balearen". Er kummerte sich weder um das Auftreten, das von einem Mitglied der Familie Habsburg erwartet wurde, noch darum, was andere uber ihn dachten. Seiner schabigen Kleidung wegen wurde er immer wieder fur einen Schafhirten oder Landarbeiter gehalten - zu seiner groSSen Belustigung. Dass er bei Hof als gelehrter Sonderling galt, kommentierte er gelassen: "Lieber vielfaltig als einfaltig".Ludwig Salvators Liebesleben war turbulent. Der Junggeselle soll beiden Geschlechtern zugetan gewesen sein und zahllose Affaren gehabt haben. Fur seine unehelichen Kinder hat er angeblich gut gesorgt. Einer seiner Liebschaften, Catalina Homar, der Tochter eines Tischlers, lieSS der Erzherzog eine exzellente Ausbildung angedeihen und machte sie schlieSSlich sogar zur Verwalterin seiner Weinguter.Ludwig Salvator war Wissenschaftler, Kunstler, Visionar, Pazifist, Naturschutzer, Schriftsteller und eine der schillerndsten Personlichkeiten aus dem Hause Habsburg.Eine Dokumentation von Rosa Maria Plattner

programme.title: Julie Andrews - Unvergessene Mary Poppins
programme.desc: If you hear the name Julie Andrews, most probably think of the most extraordinary children's girl of all time: Mary Poppins. It is less known that Andrews, who was born in Walton-on-Thames in 1935, was already a singing talent as a child and celebrated her first success in 1940-in the middle of the air battle for England-in the London subway. Plagued by stage fright and blessed with a voice range of over four octaves, Andrews rose to the favorite of the British Music Halls. In the USA, after her Broadway success, she became a musical star in Hollywood with "My Fair Lady". For her first film role in "Mary Poppins" she received a Golden Globe and an Oscar. Although she was very early in a sussen, asexual image, she also played graceful roles in films by Alfred Hitchcock, Andrej Konchalovsky and Blake Edwards. But despite her many successes, she also had to overwind the big background over the course of her decades of career. programme.title: A Habsburg on Mallorca - Ludwig Salvator and the magic of the sea / Ein Habsburger auf Mallorca - Ludwig Salvator und der Zauber des Meeres
programme.desc: Ludwig Salvator, Archduke of Austria and Prince of Tuscany, traveled and researched the Mediterranean with his sailing yacht for decades and finally settled in Mallorca.* His special interest was the research of unknown islands at the time, from the country and people, flora and fauna. He documented his trips in words and pictures. Magnificent Bucher testify to his universal work.*Archduke Ludwig Salvator von Habsburg-Lorraine and Bourbon (4.8.1847-12.10.1915) was an unpleasant, a universal genius, an dropout and nature conservationist from the very beginning. However, he was not only a fun -loving globetrotter, but also a recognized researcher of the Mediterranean, especially the Balearic Islands. He has recorded his research results on history, flora and fauna in extensive publications. The documentation shows the most important life stations of Ludwig Salvator and the sustainable effects of his research activity in the late 19th century. Throughout his life, he was driven by the desire to travel, understand and preserve. As the owner of the steam yacht "mermaid" and the "capitan spatent of the long journey", he was in the Mediterranean for decades to awaken the interest of the public for the regions that were largely unknown at the time, such as the Liparic Islands and the Ionian protective of the Balearic and the loveliness of their inhabitants particularly impressed the archduke. He created a small paradise in the northwest of Mallorca, where no animal was tired and no tree was allowed to be. For his monumental work "The Balearic Islands. Described in word and picture" he received the gold medal at the Paris World Exhibition in 1889.Annatuigent legends and anecdotes rose around the "uncrowned king of the Balearic Islands". He neither grief about the appearance that was expected by a member of the Habsburg family, nor about what others thought about him. Because of his scraping clothes, he was kept for a shepherd or farm worker - to his great amusement. He commented calmly that he was considered a scholarly nerd at Hof: "Better diverse than simple". Ludwig Salvator's love life was turbulent. The bachelor is said to have been to both sexes and have had countless affarities. He supposedly took care of his illegitimate children. One of his love affairs, Catalina Homar, the daughter of a carpenter, let the Archduke give an excellent training and finally made them the administrator of his vineyard. Ludwig Salvator was a scientist, artist, visionary, pacifist, nature conservation, writer and one of the most dazzling people from Habsburg. / Ludwig Salvator, Erzherzog von Österreich und Prinz von Toskana, bereiste und erforschte jahrzehntelang mit seiner Segelyacht "Nixe" das Mittelmeer und lieSS sich schlieSSlich auf Mallorca nieder.*Er war gebildet, unangepasst und aufgeschlossen. Sein besonderes Interesse galt der Erforschung damals unbekannter Inseln, von Land und Leuten, Flora und Fauna. Seine Reisen dokumentierte er in Wort und Bild. Prachtvolle Bucher bezeugen sein universelles Schaffen.*Erzherzog Ludwig Salvator von Habsburg-Lothringen und Bourbon (4.8.1847-12.10.1915) war ein Unangepasster, ein Universalgenie, ein Aussteiger und Natur-schutzer der ersten Stunde. Er war aber nicht nur ein lebenslustiger Globetrotter, sondern auch ein anerkannter Forscher des Mittelmeerraumes, besonders der Balearen. Seine Forschungsergebnisse uber Geschichte, Tier- und Pflanzenwelt hat er in umfangreichen Publikationen festgehalten.Die Dokumentation zeigt die wichtigsten Lebensstationen Ludwig Salvators und die nachhaltigen Auswirkungen seiner Forschertatigkeit im ausgehenden 19. Jahrhundert. Zeit seines Lebens war er getrieben von dem Verlangen zu reisen, zu verstehen und zu bewahren. Als Besitzer der Dampfsegelyacht "Nixe" und des "Kapitanspatentes der langen Fahrt" war er jahrzehntelang im Mittelmeer unterwegs, um das Interesse der Öffentlichkeit fur damals weitgehend unbekannte Regionen zu wecken, wie die Liparischen Inseln und die Ionischen Inseln.Die wilde Schonheit der Balearen und die Liebenswurdigkeit von deren Bewohnern beeindruckten den Erzherzog besonders. Er schuf sich im Nordwesten Mallorcas ein kleines Paradies, wo kein Tier getotet und kein Baum gefallt werden durfte. Fur sein Monumentalwerk "Die Balearen. Geschildert in Wort und Bild" erhielt er auf der Pariser Weltausstellung 1889 die Goldmedaille.Unzahlige Legenden und Anekdoten ranken sich um den "ungekronten Konig der Balearen". Er kummerte sich weder um das Auftreten, das von einem Mitglied der Familie Habsburg erwartet wurde, noch darum, was andere uber ihn dachten. Seiner schabigen Kleidung wegen wurde er immer wieder fur einen Schafhirten oder Landarbeiter gehalten - zu seiner groSSen Belustigung. Dass er bei Hof als gelehrter Sonderling galt, kommentierte er gelassen: "Lieber vielfaltig als einfaltig".Ludwig Salvators Liebesleben war turbulent. Der Junggeselle soll beiden Geschlechtern zugetan gewesen sein und zahllose Affaren gehabt haben. Fur seine unehelichen Kinder hat er angeblich gut gesorgt. Einer seiner Liebschaften, Catalina Homar, der Tochter eines Tischlers, lieSS der Erzherzog eine exzellente Ausbildung angedeihen und machte sie schlieSSlich sogar zur Verwalterin seiner Weinguter.Ludwig Salvator war Wissenschaftler, Kunstler, Visionar, Pazifist, Naturschutzer, Schriftsteller und eine der schillerndsten Personlichkeiten aus dem Hause Habsburg.Eine Dokumentation von Rosa Maria Plattner

programme.desc: It has always been too little to stand in the pharmacy. programme.sub-title: After the amok - an emergency chaplain in the portrait / Nach dem Amok - Ein Notfallseelsorger im Portrat
programme.desc: On June 10th, a killing spree on Borg Dreierschutzengasse in Graz shone the public. Eleven people died, at least Zwolf were seriously injured. As an evangelical religion teacher and emergency pastor, Paul Nitsche experienced this day at his school. In the hours after the killing spree, he not only had to act professionally, but also found his own way of being adopted. The 25-minute portrait shows a person who takes his responsibility seriously as a pastor and reflects his own dismay. Then in "Kreuz und across Plus": Part 1 of the series "Iconic!" - The pictures codes in religions. / Am 10. Juni erschutterte ein Amoklauf am BORG Dreierschutzengasse in Graz die Öffentlichkeit. Elf Menschen starben, mindestens zwolf wurden teils schwer verletzt. Als evangelischer Religionslehrer und Notfallseelsorger erlebte Paul Nitsche diesen Tag an seiner Schule selbst mit. Nitsche ist damit nicht nur Überlebender, sondern auch jemand, der als Notfallseelsorger anderen Halt gibt, wenn die Welt aus den Fugen gerat. Er musste in den Stunden nach dem Amoklauf nicht nur professionell handeln, sondern selbst seine eigenen Wege der Bewaltigung finden. Die erste Folge des neuen ORF-Formats "kreuz und quer NAH DRAN" begleitet den 50-Jahrigen auf seinem Weg, beruflich und privat wieder Stabilitat zu gewinnen. Das 25-minutige Portrait zeigt einen Menschen, der seine Verantwortung als Seelsorger ernst nimmt und dabei eigene Betroffenheit reflektiert. programme.desc: Beruhrendes, bildgewaltiges Portrat zweier Lichtgestalten der Moderne. programme.title: Im Tal der Schneeleoparden
programme.desc: In the shadow of the summit of the Tibetan highlands, in the Chinese province of Qinghai, there is a hidden valley where more snow leopards live than somewhere else on earth. The film follows a traditional female in search of a safe area. In a valley, the snow leopardin finds a suitable hollow in which she gives birth to two young. In the following 18 months, her life is solely about supplying the little ones with sufficient food and protecting them against all dangers that lurk in the rugged mountains: Frederic Larray processing: Doris Hochmayr / Im Schatten der Gipfel des tibetischen Hochlands, in der chinesischen Provinz Qinghai, gibt es ein verborgenes Tal, in dem mehr Schneeleoparden leben als irgendwo sonst auf der Erde.Der Film folgt einem trachtigen Weibchen auf seiner Suche nach einem sicheren Revier. In einem Tal findet die Schneeleopardin eine geeignete Hohle, in der sie zwei Junge zur Welt bringt. In den folgenden 18 Monaten dreht sich ihr Leben allein darum, die Kleinen mit ausreichend Nahrung zu versorgen und sie vor allen Gefahren zu schutzen, die uberall in der schroffen Bergwelt lauern.Regie: Frederic LarrayBearbeitung: Doris Hochmayr

programme.title: A Habsburg on Mallorca - Ludwig Salvator and the magic of the sea / Ein Habsburger auf Mallorca - Ludwig Salvator und der Zauber des Meeres
programme.desc: Ludwig Salvator, Archduke of Austria and Prince of Tuscany, traveled and researched the Mediterranean with his sailing yacht for decades and finally settled in Mallorca.* His special interest was the research of unknown islands at the time, from the country and people, flora and fauna. He documented his trips in words and pictures. Magnificent Bucher testify to his universal work.*Archduke Ludwig Salvator von Habsburg-Lorraine and Bourbon (4.8.1847-12.10.1915) was an unpleasant, a universal genius, an dropout and nature conservationist from the very beginning. However, he was not only a fun -loving globetrotter, but also a recognized researcher of the Mediterranean, especially the Balearic Islands. He has recorded his research results on history, flora and fauna in extensive publications. The documentation shows the most important life stations of Ludwig Salvator and the sustainable effects of his research activity in the late 19th century. Throughout his life, he was driven by the desire to travel, understand and preserve. As the owner of the steam yacht "mermaid" and the "capitan spatent of the long journey", he was in the Mediterranean for decades to awaken the interest of the public for the regions that were largely unknown at the time, such as the Liparic Islands and the Ionian protective of the Balearic and the loveliness of their inhabitants particularly impressed the archduke. He created a small paradise in the northwest of Mallorca, where no animal was tired and no tree was allowed to be. For his monumental work "The Balearic Islands. Described in word and picture" he received the gold medal at the Paris World Exhibition in 1889.Annatuigent legends and anecdotes rose around the "uncrowned king of the Balearic Islands". He neither grief about the appearance that was expected by a member of the Habsburg family, nor about what others thought about him. Because of his scraping clothes, he was kept for a shepherd or farm worker - to his great amusement. He commented calmly that he was considered a scholarly nerd at Hof: "Better diverse than simple". Ludwig Salvator's love life was turbulent. The bachelor is said to have been to both sexes and have had countless affarities. He supposedly took care of his illegitimate children. One of his love affairs, Catalina Homar, the daughter of a carpenter, let the Archduke give an excellent training and finally made them the administrator of his vineyard. Ludwig Salvator was a scientist, artist, visionary, pacifist, nature conservation, writer and one of the most dazzling people from Habsburg. / Ludwig Salvator, Erzherzog von Österreich und Prinz von Toskana, bereiste und erforschte jahrzehntelang mit seiner Segelyacht "Nixe" das Mittelmeer und lieSS sich schlieSSlich auf Mallorca nieder.*Er war gebildet, unangepasst und aufgeschlossen. Sein besonderes Interesse galt der Erforschung damals unbekannter Inseln, von Land und Leuten, Flora und Fauna. Seine Reisen dokumentierte er in Wort und Bild. Prachtvolle Bucher bezeugen sein universelles Schaffen.*Erzherzog Ludwig Salvator von Habsburg-Lothringen und Bourbon (4.8.1847-12.10.1915) war ein Unangepasster, ein Universalgenie, ein Aussteiger und Natur-schutzer der ersten Stunde. Er war aber nicht nur ein lebenslustiger Globetrotter, sondern auch ein anerkannter Forscher des Mittelmeerraumes, besonders der Balearen. Seine Forschungsergebnisse uber Geschichte, Tier- und Pflanzenwelt hat er in umfangreichen Publikationen festgehalten.Die Dokumentation zeigt die wichtigsten Lebensstationen Ludwig Salvators und die nachhaltigen Auswirkungen seiner Forschertatigkeit im ausgehenden 19. Jahrhundert. Zeit seines Lebens war er getrieben von dem Verlangen zu reisen, zu verstehen und zu bewahren. Als Besitzer der Dampfsegelyacht "Nixe" und des "Kapitanspatentes der langen Fahrt" war er jahrzehntelang im Mittelmeer unterwegs, um das Interesse der Öffentlichkeit fur damals weitgehend unbekannte Regionen zu wecken, wie die Liparischen Inseln und die Ionischen Inseln.Die wilde Schonheit der Balearen und die Liebenswurdigkeit von deren Bewohnern beeindruckten den Erzherzog besonders. Er schuf sich im Nordwesten Mallorcas ein kleines Paradies, wo kein Tier getotet und kein Baum gefallt werden durfte. Fur sein Monumentalwerk "Die Balearen. Geschildert in Wort und Bild" erhielt er auf der Pariser Weltausstellung 1889 die Goldmedaille.Unzahlige Legenden und Anekdoten ranken sich um den "ungekronten Konig der Balearen". Er kummerte sich weder um das Auftreten, das von einem Mitglied der Familie Habsburg erwartet wurde, noch darum, was andere uber ihn dachten. Seiner schabigen Kleidung wegen wurde er immer wieder fur einen Schafhirten oder Landarbeiter gehalten - zu seiner groSSen Belustigung. Dass er bei Hof als gelehrter Sonderling galt, kommentierte er gelassen: "Lieber vielfaltig als einfaltig".Ludwig Salvators Liebesleben war turbulent. Der Junggeselle soll beiden Geschlechtern zugetan gewesen sein und zahllose Affaren gehabt haben. Fur seine unehelichen Kinder hat er angeblich gut gesorgt. Einer seiner Liebschaften, Catalina Homar, der Tochter eines Tischlers, lieSS der Erzherzog eine exzellente Ausbildung angedeihen und machte sie schlieSSlich sogar zur Verwalterin seiner Weinguter.Ludwig Salvator war Wissenschaftler, Kunstler, Visionar, Pazifist, Naturschutzer, Schriftsteller und eine der schillerndsten Personlichkeiten aus dem Hause Habsburg.Eine Dokumentation von Rosa Maria Plattner

programme.title: Julie Andrews - Unvergessene Mary Poppins
programme.desc: If you hear the name Julie Andrews, most probably think of the most extraordinary children's girl of all time: Mary Poppins. It is less known that Andrews, who was born in Walton-on-Thames in 1935, was already a singing talent as a child and celebrated her first success in 1940-in the middle of the air battle for England-in the London subway. Plagued by stage fright and blessed with a voice range of over four octaves, Andrews rose to the favorite of the British Music Halls. In the USA, after her Broadway success, she became a musical star in Hollywood with "My Fair Lady". For her first film role in "Mary Poppins" she received a Golden Globe and an Oscar. Although she was very early in a sussen, asexual image, she also played graceful roles in films by Alfred Hitchcock, Andrej Konchalovsky and Blake Edwards. But despite her many successes, she also had to overwind the big background over the course of her decades of career. The film by Yves Rioou looks at the life of Julie Andrews with a lot of imagination and humor and unfolds a subtle poetry between music, dance and the unmistakable laughter of the actress. / Wenn sie den Namen Julie Andrews horen, denken die meisten wahrscheinlich an das auSSergewohnlichste Kindermadchen aller Zeiten: Mary Poppins. Weniger bekannt ist, dass Andrews, die 1935 in Walton-on-Thames geboren wurde, bereits als Kind ein Gesangstalent war und ihre ersten Erfolge 1940 - inmitten der Luftschlacht um England - in der Londoner U-Bahn feierte. Von Lampenfieber geplagt und mit einem Stimmumfang von uber vier Oktaven gesegnet, stieg Andrews zum Liebling der britischen Music Halls auf.In den USA avancierte sie nach ihrem Broadway-Erfolg mit "My Fair Lady" zum Musical-Star in Hollywood. Fur ihre erste Filmrolle in "Mary Poppins" erhielt sie einen Golden Globe und einen Oscar. Obwohl sie sehr fruh in einem suSSen, asexuellen Image gefangen war, spielte sie auch anmutige Rollen in Filmen von Alfred Hitchcock, Andrej Konchalovsky und Blake Edwards. Doch trotz ihrer vielen Erfolge musste sie im Laufe ihrer jahrzehntelangen Karriere auch groSSe Ruckschlage uberwinden.Der Film von Yves Riou blickt mit viel Fantasie und Humor auf das Leben von Julie Andrews und entfaltet eine subtile Poesie zwischen Musik, Tanz und dem unverwechselbaren Lachen der Schauspielerin.

programme.desc: On June 10th, a killing spree on Borg Dreierschutzengasse in Graz shone the public. Eleven people died, at least Zwolf were seriously injured. programme.desc: It has always been too little to stand in the pharmacy. Etwa 2.000 Menschen, vorwiegend Manner aus Österreich und Deutschland, kommen auch heuer wieder zum groSSten LGBTIQ-Festival dieser Art in Österreich.Die Dokumentation aus dem Landesstudio Karnten soll die Vielfalt dieser touristischen GroSSveranstaltung zeigen, auch die positiven Auswirkungen auf die Region und die Denkmuster der Menschen.Die Vergangenheit war fur die Regenbogen-Community nicht einfach, der Schmerz von Verfolgung und Verurteilungen sitzt tief.
