programme.title: Basketball - ABA League: Partizan - Krka / Košarka - ABA liga: Partizan - Krka
programme.desc: The ABA League was established by the best basketball clubs from Bosnia and Herzegovina, Montenegro, Croatia, Serbia and Slovenia. As such consists of clubs from the space of the former SFRY and representatives of Hungary, Bulgaria, Israel and the Czech Republic were still involved in it. On several occasions, it also changed the name depending on the sponsor, and today is the official name of Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League. The competition is played in two parts, the first part takes place by playing two games, each, with each, one on the domestic terrain and one on the guest field, ie along the two-circular league system. The second part of the competition or playoff differs from season to season. / ABA liga je osnovana od strane najboljih košarkaških klubova iz Bosne i Hercegovine, Crne Gore, Hrvatske, Srbije i Slovenije. Kao takva sastoji se od klubova sa prostora bivše SFRJ te su u njoj još učestvovali predstavnici Mađarske, Bugarske, Izraela i Češke. U nekoliko navrata je menjala i naziv u zavisnosti od sponzora, a danas joj je službeni naziv Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League. Takmičenje se igra u dva dela, prvi deo se odvija tako što sve ekipe igraju po dve utakmice, svako, sa svakim, jednu na domaćem terenu i jednu na gostujućem terenu, odnosno po dvokružnom liga sistemu. programme.title: Košarka - Kls: Tamiš - Dynamic / Košarka - KLS: Tamiš - Dynamic
programme.desc: Serbia has its first basketball league as the highest rank of professional basketball in that country. The League itself was founded in 2006. and as such as 14 teams. The competition takes place according to the subcircular point system and in mutual meetings each club hosts one time and by one guest. It is interesting in this part of the competition, Serbian clubs playing in this part of the competition, which play the regional ABA league. After the first part of the four best clubs are placed in the Super League in which clubs that played a regional competition are placed only then and in that phase, the Champions of Serbia is decided. The number of clubs that will be placed in the Super League depends on the number of representatives in the regional league, but in that part of the competition, there are always 8 teams. / Srbija ima svoju prvu košarkašku ligu kao najviši rang profesionalne košarke u toj zemlji. Sama liga osnovana je 2006. godine i kao takva broji 14 timova. Takmičenje se odvija po dvokružnom bod sistemu te je u međusobnim susretima svaki klub jedan put domaćin i po jednom gost. Zanimljivost je što u ovom delu takmičenja ne nastupaju i srpski klubovi koji igraju regionalnu ABA ligu. Nakon prvog dela četiri najbolja kluba se plasiraju u Superligu u kojoj se tek tada priključuju klubovi koji su igrali regionalno takmičenje i u toj fazi se odlučuje o prvaku Srbije. Broj klubova koji će se plasirati u Superligu zavisi o broju predstavnika u regionalnoj ligi, no u tom delu takmičenja se uvek nalazi 8 timova.

programme.title: Basketball - Aba Liga: Buducnost - Spartak / Košarka - ABA liga: Budućnost - Spartak
programme.desc: The ABA League was established by the best basketball clubs from Bosnia and Herzegovina, Montenegro, Croatia, Serbia and Slovenia. Takmičenje se igra u dva dela, prvi deo se odvija tako što sve ekipe igraju po dve utakmice, svako, sa svakim, jednu na domaćem terenu i jednu na gostujućem terenu, odnosno po dvokružnom liga sistemu. programme.title: Alfred Dunhill Links Championship

programme.title: Football: Wwin Liga BiH: Radnik - Široki Brijeg / Fudbal: WWIN Liga BIH: Radnik - Široki Brijeg
programme.desc: Founded in 2000. The Premier League of Bosnia and Herzegovina is the highest ranking of the football competition in BiH. The entrance of the cubes from the Republika Srpska two years later received a format with 16 clubs in the two-circular competition system. Today, 12 teams competed in the league, which has been divided into league after the 22-year-in-law and the league for survival. The first historical champion of BiH was a leotar from Trebinje. The club with the most conquered championship titles is Zrinjski from Mostar. The largest European success is the placement of the railway worker in the UEFA Cup semifinals in 1984. Years. / Osnovana 2000. godine Premijer liga Bosne i Hercegovine najviši je rang fudbalskog takmičenja u BiH. Ulaskom kubova iz Republike Srpske dve godine kasnije liga dobija format sa 16 klubova u dvokružnom sistemu takmičenja. Danas se u ligi takmiči 12 ekipa koje se nakon 22 odigrana kola dele na Ligu za prvaka i Ligu za opstanak. Prvi istorijski prvak BiH bio je Leotar iz Trebinja. Klub sa najviše osvojenih titula prvaka je Zrinjski iz Mostara. Najveći evropski uspeh je plasman Željezničara u polufinale kupa UEFA 1984. godine.

programme.title: Fudbal - Danish Liga: Fredericia - Brondby / Fudbal - Danska liga: Fredericia - Brondby
programme.desc: Denmark Football League and its strongest Danish football rank is known as Super League and was founded in 1991. years. programme.title: Basketball - ABA League: Cedevita Olympia - Mega / Košarka - ABA liga: Cedevita Olimpija - Mega
programme.desc: The ABA League was established by the best basketball clubs from Bosnia and Herzegovina, Montenegro, Croatia, Serbia and Slovenia. As such consists of clubs from the space of the former SFRY and representatives of Hungary, Bulgaria, Israel and the Czech Republic were still involved in it. On several occasions, it also changed the name depending on the sponsor, and today is the official name of Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League. The competition is played in two parts, the first part takes place by playing two games, each, with each, one on the domestic terrain and one on the guest field, ie along the two-circular league system. The second part of the competition or playoff differs from season to season. / ABA liga je osnovana od strane najboljih košarkaških klubova iz Bosne i Hercegovine, Crne Gore, Hrvatske, Srbije i Slovenije. Kao takva sastoji se od klubova sa prostora bivše SFRJ te su u njoj još učestvovali predstavnici Mađarske, Bugarske, Izraela i Češke. U nekoliko navrata je menjala i naziv u zavisnosti od sponzora, a danas joj je službeni naziv Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League. Takmičenje se igra u dva dela, prvi deo se odvija tako što sve ekipe igraju po dve utakmice, svako, sa svakim, jednu na domaćem terenu i jednu na gostujućem terenu, odnosno po dvokružnom liga sistemu. Drugi deo takmičenja odnosno plejof se razlikuje od sezone do sezone.

programme.title: Majke šampioni
programme.desc: In the six semi-municipal episodes, the interlocutors were mothers of large, trophy athletes who, everyone in their own way, marked the history of sports of these areas. Through what difficulties and waivers are the parents face when it is necessary to see the talent of your children? What's the moment, when you see in which direction they move their lives? How long does it take to make dreams come true, and how much to never come to these achievements? Unfortunately, during the series for TV Arena, the sport will also talk to the mother who was awarded the largest world tragedy, the loss of the child. About the deaths of their sons, the strengths were forces to talk mothers Dražen Petrović and Haris Brkić. Lifebers, laughter and tears, strong emotions would describe the six episodes of the series in which their lives and parenting represented Mothers of Novak Djokovic, Jelena Brooks, Luka Jovića, as well as mothers of the tragicly killed Drazen Petrovic and Haris Brkić. / U šest polusatnih epizoda sagovornice su bile majke velikih, trofejnih sportista koji su, svako na svoj način, obeležili istoriju sporta ovih prostora. Kroz kakve teškoće i odricanja se suočavaju roditelji kada je neophodno ispratiti talenat svoje dece? Koji je to trenutak, kada vidite u kom pravcu kreću njihovi životi? Koliko je potrebno da se snovi ostvare, a koliko da do tih ostvarenja nikada ni ne dođe? Nažalost, tokom serijala za TV Arena sport govoriće i majke koje je zadesila najveća ovozemaljska tragedija, gubitak deteta. O pogibijama svojih sinova smogle su snage da pričaju majke Dražena Petrovića i Harisa Brkića. Životni ringišpil, smeh i suze, snažne emocije… tako bi u najkraćem opisali šest epizoda serijala u kojima su svoje živote i roditeljstvo predstavile majke Novaka Đokovića, Ivane Španović, Jelene Bruks, Luke Jovića kao i majke tragično nastradalih Dražena Petrovića i Harisa Brkića.

programme.title: Football - Montenegrin League: Future - Lake / Fudbal - Crnogorska liga: Budućnost - Jezero
programme.desc: The Montenegrin football league was founded in 2004. years but the first season was played in 2006/2007. after the independence of the state. 12 Clubs in a three-round system of the competition struggled for the title of the champion, which finally won Zeta from Golubovac, which was the only title of the Champions of Montenegro. programme.title: Football (M): Maribor - Domzale, first League Telemach 2025/2026 / Nogomet (M): Maribor - Domzale, Prva liga Telemach 2025/2026
programme.desc: The Slovenian first league was founded in 1991, after Slovenia became an independent state with the collapse of the former Yugoslavia. By 1990, the Slovenian Republican League was one of the lower leagues in Yugoslav football. Until the breakup of Yugoslavia, only a few clubs played in the highest football rank of the then country. After establishing independence, only two clubs have never dropped out of the highest rank of Slovenian football, namely Celje and Maribor. The league consists of ten teams, each playing four matches - two at home and two away, the last team on the rankings falls out, and the penultimate in qualifying is fighting for existence. / Slovenska prva liga je bila ustanovljena leta 1991, potem ko je Slovenija z razpadom nekdanje Jugoslavije postala samostojna država. Do leta 1990 je bila slovenska republiška liga ena izmed nižjih lig v jugoslovanskem nogometu. Do razpada Jugoslavije je v najvišjem nogometnem rangu takratne države igralo le nekaj klubov. Po ustanovitvi neodvisnosti le dva kluba nikoli nista izpadla iz najvišjega ranga slovenskega nogometa, in sicer Celje in Maribor. programme.title: Football (M): Maribor - Domzale, first League Telemach 2025/2026 / Nogomet (M): Maribor - Domzale, Prva liga Telemach 2025/2026
programme.desc: The Slovenian first league was founded in 1991, after Slovenia became an independent state with the collapse of the former Yugoslavia. By 1990, the Slovenian Republican League was one of the lower leagues in Yugoslav football. Until the breakup of Yugoslavia, only a few clubs played in the highest football rank of the then country. After establishing independence, only two clubs have never dropped out of the highest rank of Slovenian football, namely Celje and Maribor. The league consists of ten teams, each playing four matches - two at home and two away, the last team on the rankings falls out, and the penultimate in qualifying is fighting for existence. / Slovenska prva liga je bila ustanovljena leta 1991, potem ko je Slovenija z razpadom nekdanje Jugoslavije postala samostojna država. programme.title: Football (M): Maribor - Domzale, first League Telemach 2025/2026 / Nogomet (M): Maribor - Domzale, Prva liga Telemach 2025/2026
programme.desc: The Slovenian first league was founded in 1991, after Slovenia became an independent state with the collapse of the former Yugoslavia. By 1990, the Slovenian Republican League was one of the lower leagues in Yugoslav football. Until the breakup of Yugoslavia, only a few clubs played in the highest football rank of the then country. After establishing independence, only two clubs have never dropped out of the highest rank of Slovenian football, namely Celje and Maribor. The league consists of ten teams, each playing four matches - two at home and two away, the last team on the rankings falls out, and the penultimate in qualifying is fighting for existence. / Slovenska prva liga je bila ustanovljena leta 1991, potem ko je Slovenija z razpadom nekdanje Jugoslavije postala samostojna država. Do leta 1990 je bila slovenska republiška liga ena izmed nižjih lig v jugoslovanskem nogometu. Do razpada Jugoslavije je v najvišjem nogometnem rangu takratne države igralo le nekaj klubov. Po ustanovitvi neodvisnosti le dva kluba nikoli nista izpadla iz najvišjega ranga slovenskega nogometa, in sicer Celje in Maribor. Liga je sestavljena iz desetih moštev, od katerih vsako igra po štiri tekme - dve doma in dve v gosteh, zadnja ekipa na lestvici izpade, predzadnja pa se v kvalifikacijah bori za obstanek.

Liga je sestavljena iz desetih moštev, od katerih vsako igra po štiri tekme - dve doma in dve v gosteh, zadnja ekipa na lestvici izpade, predzadnja pa se v kvalifikacijah bori za obstanek.

programme.title: Football (M): Maribor - Domzale, first League Telemach 2025/2026 / Nogomet (M): Maribor - Domzale, Prva liga Telemach 2025/2026
programme.desc: The Slovenian first league was founded in 1991, after Slovenia became an independent state with the collapse of the former Yugoslavia. By 1990, the Slovenian Republican League was one of the lower leagues in Yugoslav football. Until the breakup of Yugoslavia, only a few clubs played in the highest football rank of the then country. After establishing independence, only two clubs have never dropped out of the highest rank of Slovenian football, namely Celje and Maribor. The league consists of ten teams, each playing four matches - two at home and two away, the last team on the rankings falls out, and the penultimate in qualifying is fighting for existence. / Slovenska prva liga je bila ustanovljena leta 1991, potem ko je Slovenija z razpadom nekdanje Jugoslavije postala samostojna država. Do leta 1990 je bila slovenska republiška liga ena izmed nižjih lig v jugoslovanskem nogometu. Do razpada Jugoslavije je v najvišjem nogometnem rangu takratne države igralo le nekaj klubov. programme.desc: A lonely adventurer often approaches the point from which there is no return. He had already flown in the northern course, the highest mountain of the world, landed in Antarctica, flew over the ocean sixteen hours without stopping, and surrounded the world three times by plane. With his friends Bogdan Biščak and Rad Fabjan, they climbed the first Yugoslavs on the Mite Mountain Fitz Roy and Cerro Torre. The travels made a deeper sense when he realized Grisha Močnik, who explores the influence of black carbon on climate and our lives. These tiny black particles remain in the atmosphere for a few weeks, penetrating our respiratory tract, blood and even to the brain. Due to air pollution with black carbon, seven million people die prematurely every year. In the Alps, the more and more conditional intrusions of desert sand, which promotes glacier melting. Grisha flies over the greenery islands to help improve climate models. It is taken across the Patagonian glaciers by Glaciologist Peter Skvarča, who witnessed the collapse of ice sheets in Antarctica. Through the endless Pacific Ocean, it reaches India. In this Himalayan country, they use gross domestic happiness instead of gross domestic product. We have come to the point where humanity will no longer have an impact on the increasingly common catastrophic natural catch. If we do not change our civilizational values, our world will establish a different balance, which will take millions of climate, economic and war refugees. The documentary film by Matevž Lenarčič, Amir Muratovic and Rada Likon was presented at numerous festivals and received the Iris Award for photography. Ti drobni črni delci ostanejo v ozračju nekaj tednov, prodrejo v naša dihala, v kri in celo do možganov. Zaradi onesnaženosti zraka s črnim ogljikom vsako leto prezgodaj umre sedem milijonov ljudi.Lenarčiča pot vodi v Sarajevo, ki je med najbolj onesnaženimi mesti na svetu. V tej himalajski državici pri oceni na-predka namesto bruto domačega proizvoda za merilo uporabljajo bruto domačo srečo. Prišli smo do točke, ko človeštvo ne bo imelo več vpliva na vse pogostejše katastrofalne naravne ujme. Če ne bomo spremenili svojih civilizacijskih vrednot, bo naš svet vzpostavil drugačno ravnotežje, to pa bo pognalo na pot milijone podnebnih, ekonomskih in vojnih beguncev.Dokumentarni film Matevža Lenarčiča, Amirja Muratovića in Rada Likona je bil predstavljen že na števil-nih festivalih in je prejel nagrado IRIS za fotografijo. programme.title: Alex Hugo
programme.sub-title: For better or worse / Para bien o para mal

programme.title: Albert's garden - shared waters / Il giardino di Albert - Acque condivise
programme.desc: All populations for centuries settled in the Alpine know that managing the water resource in an oculated and shared way is essential to be able to live and grow. The Vallesans of the Middle Ages also knew. Towards the thirteenth century they began to build an extraordinary network of channels, which collected glaciers' merger lacquares, to convey it to the valley and distribute it where there was a need. These channels are called "bisses" and today represent one historical testimony of hydraulic unhinestone made of common sense, audacity and pragmatism. Thanks to the bisses lagoraltura, viticulture and pastoralism Vallesane have been able to develop and thrive. People learned to share lacquets and manage them in an fair way. Unfortunately, by the end of the century, many glaciers are destined to disappear or at least reduce themselves drastically. What will be this network of channels? The water issue is crucial in the Canton Valais, already seriously affected by climate change. Between torrential rains, debrical flows, floods, late frosts, hailstorms and drought periods, the challenges are manifold and complex. The documentary proposed today by the Albert garden highlights these problems, reminding us that the management of water is not only an environmental, but also economic and social question. Faced with potential conflicts, the functioning of bisses - based on consortium management - could it represent a form of administration controlled by citizens for the sustainability of ecosystems? Between tourist, environmental, and socio -economic challenges, the Bisses Vallesani tell us a story that draws on ancestral knowledge to ferry them in about - ours - in which high -tech solutions may not be the only ones to offer us winning options. It is no coincidence that in 2023 the Bisses of the Valais entered the right to be part of the intangible heritage of the Unnesco. / Tutte le popolazioni da secoli insediate nellarco alpino sanno che gestire la risorsa idrica in maniera oculata e condivisa è fondamentale per poterci vivere e crescere. Lo sapevano anche i vallesani del Medioevo. Verso il XIII secolo iniziarono a costruire una straordinaria rete di canali, che raccoglieva lacqua di fusione dei ghiacciai, per convogliarla a valle e distribuirla dove vi era necessità. Questi canali sono chiamati "bisses" e rappresentano oggi uneccezionale testimonianza storica di uningegneria idraulica fatta di buon senso, audacia e pragmatismo. Grazie ai bisses lagricoltura, la viticoltura e la pastorizia vallesane hanno potuto svilupparsi e prosperare. La gente ha imparato a condividere lacqua e a gestirla in maniera equa. Purtroppo, entro la fine del secolo, molti ghiacciai sono destinati a scomparire o perlomeno a ridursi drasticamente. Che ne sarà di questa rete di canali? La questione idrica è cruciale nel Canton Vallese, già gravemente colpito dai cambiamenti climatici. Tra piogge torrenziali, colate detritiche, inondazioni, gelate tardive, grandinate e periodi di siccità, le sfide sono molteplici e complesse. Il documentario proposto oggi dal giardino di Albert mette in luce queste problematiche, ricordandoci che la gestione dellacqua non è soltanto una questione ambientale, ma anche economica e sociale. Di fronte a potenziali conflitti, il funzionamento dei bisses - basato sulla gestione consortile - potrebbe forse rappresentare una forma di amministrazione controllata dai cittadini per la sostenibilità degli ecosistemi? Tra sfide turistiche, ambientali, e socioeconomiche, i bisses vallesani ci raccontano una storia che attinge a saperi ancestrali per traghettarli in unepoca - la nostra - in cui le soluzioni high-tech potrebbero non essere le sole a offrirci delle opzioni vincenti. Non a caso nel 2023 i bisses del Vallese sono entrati di diritto a far parte del Patrimonio immateriale dellUmanità dellUNESCO.

programme.title: Paganini
programme.desc: "Magic Larte is the one that gives us back the wonderful to the heart of everyday life": thus the writer Andre Breton expressed himself and - thanking the father of surrealism for the quote and the starting point - it is precisely to the size of the magic that the episode of Paganini on Sunday 5 October is aimed, from 10.30 on RSI LA1. The "Livermore Sciò" - starring Davide Livermore, now acclaimed opera director - was one of the most fun and witty serial productions in the RSI music sector. In the episodium entitled "Magic Music", they alternated, next to the Holy House, Locchestra of the Teatro Regio di Torino directed by Carlo Boccadoro, a group of Madrigalists, the musicians Oliviero Giovannoni and Diego Fasolis. Sorcellerie - literally: witchcraft - it is instead a recent French show that features the duo of Pianisti Jatekok (with works by Hector Berlioz, Franz Liszt, Camille Saint -Saëns and Paul Dukas) and two mimi/magicians engaged in a suggestive Dombre theater. Finally, Fantasymphony is a limmaginific symphonic program of the Danish National Symphony Orchestra directed by Christian Schumann who - with the subtitle "A concert of magic and fire" - offers a selection of film songs, series and video games that deal with the theme of magic and fantastic. Some examples? The soundtrack of Harry Potter written by John Williams, Lorne Balfe's music for the BBC/HBO His Dark Materials series - These dark subjects, the song Breath of Life of Florence and the Machine for the Biancaneve and the Hunter film, the famous theme of Ramin Djawadi for Game of Thrones or the Music Suite from the series from the series Netflix The Witcher written by Sonya Belousova together with Ticinese Giona Ostinelli. - Livermore Sciò - Magic Music - Sorcelleries for two piano - Fantasymphony - A concert of magic and fire / "Larte magica è quella che ci restituisce il meraviglioso al cuore della vita quotidiana": così si esprimeva lo scrittore Andre Breton e - ringraziando il padre del surrealismo per la citazione e lo spunto - è proprio alla dimensione del magico che si rivolge la puntata di Paganini di domenica 5 ottobre, dalle 10.30 su RSI LA1. Il "Livermore Sciò" - con protagonista Davide Livermore, oggi acclamato regista operistico - è stata una delle produzioni seriali più divertenti e argute del settore musicale RSI. Nellepisodio intitolato "Musica magica" si alternavano, accanto allistrionico padrone di casa, lOrchestra del Teatro Regio di Torino diretta da Carlo Boccadoro, un gruppo di madrigalisti, i musicisti Oliviero Giovannoni e Diego Fasolis. Sorcellerie - letteralmente: stregoneria - è invece un recente spettacolo francese che vede protagonisti il duo di pianiste Jatekok (con opere di Hector Berlioz, Franz Liszt, Camille Saint-Saëns e Paul Dukas) e due mimi/maghi impegnati in un suggestivo teatro dombre. Fantasymphony è infine limmaginifico programma sinfonico della Danish National Symphony Orchestra diretta da Christian Schumann che - con il sottotitolo «un concerto di magia e fuoco» - propone una selezione di brani da film, serie e videogiochi che affrontano il tema del magico e del fantastico. Alcuni esempi? La colonna sonora di Harry Potter scritta da John Williams, le musiche di Lorne Balfe per la serie BBC/HBO His Dark Materials - Queste oscure materie, il brano Breath of Life di Florence and the Machine per il film Biancaneve e il cacciatore, il celebre tema di Ramin Djawadi per Game of Thrones o ancora la Suite musicale dalla serie Netflix The Witcher scritta da Sonya Belousova assieme al ticinese Giona Ostinelli. - Livermore Sciò - Musica magica - Sorcellerie per due pianoforti - Fantasymphony - Un concerto di magia e fuoco

programme.title: Storie
programme.desc: In the juror, the pair of wolves M351 and F77 gave birth to a pack, leaving a deep mark in the area. Their attacks on cattle exasperated the breeders, to push the cantonal authorities to order the demolition of all the specimens. Fabrice, a shepherd who has learned to protect his sheep without resorting to weapons, chooses another way: follow the traces of the wolves, understand their movements and try to save them. His is a race against time: it remains just over a month before the hunting ended, and the Guardiacaccia have already knocked down almost all the pack. A silent but tight confrontation is born, almost a "war between gentlemen": on the one hand the Guardiacaccia, loyal to the mandate received, on the other Fabrice, which sees in wolves not a threat, but an essential part of natural balance. It is a challenge made of mutual respect, but of irreconcilable objectives. A story of resistance and survival, in which the line between protection and necessity becomes thin, and where the final question remains suspended: will Fabrice manage to save the last wolf, or will it be too late? A documentary by Matteo Born / Nel Giura, la coppia di lupi M351 e F77 ha dato vita a un branco, lasciando un segno profondo nel territorio. I loro attacchi al bestiame hanno esasperato gli allevatori, fino a spingere le autorità cantonali a ordinare l’abbattimento di tutti gli esemplari. Fabrice, un pastore che ha imparato a proteggere le proprie pecore senza ricorrere alle armi, sceglie un’altra strada: seguire le tracce dei lupi, comprenderne i movimenti e tentare di salvarli. La sua è una corsa contro il tempo: resta poco più di un mese prima che la caccia si concluda, e i guardiacaccia hanno già abbattuto quasi tutto il branco .Ne nasce un confronto silenzioso ma serrato, quasi una “guerra tra gentiluomini”: da un lato i guardiacaccia, ligi al mandato ricevuto, dall’altro Fabrice, che vede nei lupi non una minaccia, ma una parte essenziale dell’equilibrio naturale. È una sfida fatta di rispetto reciproco, ma di obiettivi inconciliabili. Una storia di resistenza e sopravvivenza, in cui la linea tra protezione e necessità diventa sottile, e dove la domanda finale resta sospesa: riuscirà Fabrice a salvare l’ultimo lupo, o sarà troppo tardi?Un documentario di Matteo Born

programme.title: The lady in yellow / La signora in giallo
programme.desc: The lady in yellow (original title Murder, She Wrote) is an American yellow show, with the participation of Angela Lansbury in the role of the protagonist Jessica Fletcher. He aired weekly on the CBS from 1984 to 1996 and continued, with several TV-Movie, until 2003 (as a wagon read with murder, the ballad of the lost boy and appointment with death). Angela Lansbury played the role of executive producer of the show in her last seasons. Jessica Fletcher is a perspective writer of yellow, which is often dealing with with mysterious murders, for which she always manages to discover the culprit. Jessica Fletcher lives in a small village, the fictitious Cabot Cove in Maine. programme.title: Bonfire / Falò
programme.desc: Gaza, the trap of the Aid of Emiliano Bos exactly two years after the start of the war in response to the Hamas massacre of 7 October 2023, while the current affairs recorded peace proposals awaiting developments, we returned to Israel this time to document the traps of the aid system, also entering the large food deposit inside the strip where the mountains of boxes and bags of flour lie in Gaza. half a million Palestinians. Meanwhile, thousands of civilians killed waiting for a food package are now. In the Gaza strip we don't only die from Israeli bombs. For months, a growing number of Palestinians has been hit while desperately trying to grab food. The very few food distribution points have turned into gigantic militarized traps. Ocular witnesses and international organizations accuse the Israeli army of war crimes because it shoots against people waiting for humanitarian assistance. A version confirmed as a bonfire by a former contractor of the discussed "Gaza Humanitarian Foundation" (GHF), the American organization desired by the White House to which Israel has contracted most of the management of aid to Gaza by subtracting it from the UN. Gaza, what does Switzerland do? Di Marzio Pescia and Damiano Dignola demonstrations in the square, appeals, open letters, complaints and petitions. As in many other countries, even in Switzerland there is a civil society that mobilizes and asks for sanctions against Israel and concrete measures to end the tragedy of the civilian population in the Gaza strip. However, official Switzerland does not want to know. The words of condemnation and the invitations to a cease are not lacking fire, but nothing more. Is this right? Hebron, an enforceable lives of Emiliano Bos a railing to protect himself from the attacks of the settlers, the closed military check-point returning from work, the curfew which makes you live as in prison. The rumors from Hebron, the historic Palestinian city where the soldiers protect the settlers within a now desert urban center. And the voices from Ma’Ale Adumim, where instead the Israeli mayor defines the expansion of the enormous settlement "natural" to create continuity with Jerusalem, a project just approved after thirty years of waiting. Separate, segregated, often locked up lives, in a West Bank where history and geography intertwine inexorably while the hypothesis of the "two states" seems more and more to blend. Falò has collected the testimonies of those who cannot escape and feel in a cage. And of those who say they are convinced that "all this will be Israel". And that the Palestinians will continue to have a freedom of movement. A right that today, when you travel these separate roads, appears really trampled. The raids of the settlers of Katie Arnold since the beginning of the war of 7 October 2023, in the West Bank thousands of Palestinians have been displaced. In Israel, it is ethnicity, not citizenship, which determines if your home survives. This report documents an attack of settlers, this time in a Bedouin village. There are about 200 thousand Bedouins who live in the Negev desert but, despite being citizens of Israel, the state destroys their homes. And so, in some areas the Israeli settlements are built above the rubble of the Bedouin houses, whose inhabitants, not having another place to live, have to start building again. / Gaza, la trappola degli aiuti di Emiliano Bos A due anni esatti dall’inizio della guerra in risposta al massacro di Hamas del 7 ottobre 2023, mentre l’attualità registra proposte di pace in attesa di sviluppi, siamo tornati in Israele questa volta per documentare le trappole del sistema degli aiuti, entrando anche nel grande deposito alimentare dentro la Striscia dove giacciono montagne di scatolame e sacchi di farina quando a Gaza la carestia colpisce mezzo milione di palestinesi. Intanto sono ormai migliaia i civili uccisi in attesa di un pacco alimentare. Nella Striscia di Gaza non si muore solo per le bombe israeliane. Da mesi un numero crescente di palestinesi viene colpito mentre cerca disperatamente di accaparrarsi del cibo. I pochissimi punti di distribuzione alimentare si sono trasformati in gigantesche trappole militarizzate. Testimoni oculari e organizzazioni internazionali accusano l’esercito israeliano di crimini di guerra perche spara contro la gente in attesa di assistenza umanitaria. Una versione confermata a Falò da un ex contractor della discussa “Gaza Humanitarian Foundation” (GHF), l’organizzazione americana voluta dalla Casa Bianca a cui Israele ha appaltato gran parte della gestione degli aiuti a Gaza sottraendola all’ONU. Gaza, cosa fa la Svizzera? di Marzio Pescia e Damiano Dignola Manifestazioni di piazza, appelli, lettere aperte, denunce e petizioni. Come in molti altri Paesi, anche in Svizzera c’è una società civile che si mobilita e chiede sanzioni contro Israele e misure concrete per porre fine alla tragedia della popolazione civile nella Striscia di Gaza. La Svizzera ufficiale però non vuole saperne. Le parole di condanna e gli inviti ad un cessate il fuoco non mancano, ma niente di più. È giusto così?Hebron, vite rinchiuse di Emiliano Bos Un’inferriata per proteggersi dagli attacchi dei coloni, il check-point militare chiuso tornando dal lavoro, il coprifuoco che ti fa vivere come in prigione. Le voci da Hebron, la storica città palestinese dove i soldati proteggono i coloni all’interno di un centro urbano ormai deserto. E le voci da Ma’ale Adumim, dove invece il sindaco israeliano definisce “naturale” l’espansione dell’enorme insediamento fino a creare continuità con Gerusalemme, un progetto appena approvato dopo trent’anni di attesa. Vite separate, segregate, spesso rinchiuse, in una Cisgiordania dove storia e geografia s’intrecciano inesorabilmente mentre sembra sfumare sempre più l’ipotesi dei “due Stati”. Falò ha raccolto le testimonianze di chi non può scappare e si sente in una gabbia. E di chi si dice convinto che “tutto questo sarà Israele”. E che i palestinesi continueranno ad avere una libertà di movimento. Un diritto che oggi, quando si percorrono queste strade separate, appare davvero calpestato. Le razzie dei coloni di Katie Arnold Dall’inizio della guerra del 7 ottobre 2023, in Cisgiordania migliaia di palestinesi sono stati sfollati. In Israele, è l’etnia, non la cittadinanza, che determina se la tua casa sopravvive. Questo reportage documenta un attacco di coloni, questa volta in un villaggio beduino. Sono circa 200mila i beduini che vivono nel deserto del Negev ma, nonostante siano cittadini di Israele, lo Stato distrugge le loro case. E così, in alcune zone gli insediamenti israeliani vengono costruiti sopra le macerie delle case beduine, i cui abitanti, non avendo un altro posto dove vivere, devono ricominciare a costruire.

programme.title: The lady in yellow / La signora in giallo
programme.desc: The lady in yellow (original title Murder, She Wrote) is an American yellow show, with the participation of Angela Lansbury in the role of the protagonist Jessica Fletcher. He aired weekly on the CBS from 1984 to 1996 and continued, with several TV-Movie, until 2003 (as a wagon read with murder, the ballad of the lost boy and appointment with death). Angela Lansbury played the role of executive producer of the show in her last seasons. Jessica Fletcher is a perspective writer of yellow, which is often dealing with with mysterious murders, for which she always manages to discover the culprit. Jessica Fletcher lives in a small village, the fictitious Cabot Cove in Maine. Although much of the success of La Signora in Yellow is due to the style and interpretative finesse of its protagonist, Angela Lansbury was not the first choice of the manufacturer. The part had been initially offered to Jean Stapleton and Doris Day, who however refused. / La signora in giallo (titolo originale Murder, She Wrote) è un telefilm statunitense giallo, con la partecipazione di Angela Lansbury nel ruolo della protagonista Jessica Fletcher. È andato in onda settimanalmente sulla CBS dal 1984 al 1996 e continuò, con diversi TV-movie, fino al 2003 (come Vagone letto con omicidio, La ballata del ragazzo perduto e Appuntamento con la morte). Angela Lansbury ricoprì il ruolo di produttore esecutivo del telefilm nelle sue ultime stagioni.Jessica Fletcher è una perspicace scrittrice di gialli, che si trova spesso a che fare con misteriosi omicidi, per i quali riesce sempre a scoprire il colpevole. Jessica Fletcher vive in un piccolo borgo, la fittizia Cabot Cove nel Maine. Nonostante gran parte del successo de La signora in giallo sia dovuto allo stile e alla finezza interpretativa della sua protagonista, Angela Lansbury non è stata la prima scelta del produttore. La parte era stato offerta inizialmente a Jean Stapleton e Doris Day, che però rifiutarono.

programme.title: No Other Land
programme.desc: No Other Land, Oscar for best documentary in 2025 and winner of Dargento to the Berlinal, is a work that offers a testimony of the Israeli military occupation in the Palestinian West Bank. Directed by the Israeli-Palestinian collective composed of Basel Adra, Yuval Abraham, Hamdan Ballal and Rachel Szor, tells of an experience of activism in the context of the village of Masafer Yatta whose inhabitants, day after day, live the trauma of forced demolitions and sudden imposed by the Israelis and subsequent adaptations of those who find themselves without a home. Lincomunicability between the two communities is here sanctioned by the dialogue between Basel and Yuval, a Palestinian and the Israeli laltter, who share a sense of care for the alter that seems to be lost and that bring the viewer back to the profound need for sharing and justice that characterizes every human being, the only way that can be traveled towards peace. / No Other Land, Oscar come miglior documentario nel 2025 e vincitore dellOrso dArgento alla Berlinale, è unopera che offre una testimonianza delloccupazione militare israeliana nella Cisgiordania palestinese. Diretta dal collettivo israelo-palestinese composto da Basel Adra, Yuval Abraham, Hamdan Ballal e Rachel Szor, racconta di unesperienza di attivismo nel contesto del villaggio di Masafer Yatta i cui abitanti, giorno dopo giorno, vivono il trauma delle demolizioni forzate e improvvise imposte dagli israeliani e dei successivi adattamenti di chi si ritrova senza casa. Lincomunicabilità tra le due comunità è qui sanata dal dialogo tra Basel e Yuval, uno palestinese e laltro israeliano, che condividono un senso di cura per laltro che sembra ormai perduto e che riportano lo spettatore al profondo bisogno di condivisione e giustizia che caratterizza ogni essere umano, unica strada percorribile verso la pace.

programme.title: Segni dei tempi
programme.desc: Over 33'000 LEGO bricks, more than 500 hours of work, 5 months of design: Samuele Jenni has created a model of the reformed church of Poschiavo in scale 1:40. In signs of the times, however, we also tell you the story of this religious building, built almost 400 years ago. / Oltre 33’000 mattoncini Lego, più di 500 ore di lavoro, 5 mesi di progettazione: Samuele Jenni ha realizzato un modellino della chiesa riformata di Poschiavo in scala 1:40. A Segni dei Tempi vi raccontiamo però anche la storia di questo edificio religioso, costruito quasi 400 anni fa.

programme.title: Paganini
programme.desc: "Magic Larte is the one that gives us back the wonderful to the heart of everyday life": thus the writer Andre Breton expressed himself and - thanking the father of surrealism for the quote and the starting point - it is precisely to the size of the magic that the episode of Paganini on Sunday 5 October is aimed, from 10.30 on RSI LA1. The "Livermore Sciò" - starring Davide Livermore, now acclaimed opera director - was one of the most fun and witty serial productions in the RSI music sector. In the episodium entitled "Magic Music", they alternated, next to the Holy House, Locchestra of the Teatro Regio di Torino directed by Carlo Boccadoro, a group of Madrigalists, the musicians Oliviero Giovannoni and Diego Fasolis. Sorcellerie - literally: witchcraft - it is instead a recent French show that features the duo of Pianisti Jatekok (with works by Hector Berlioz, Franz Liszt, Camille Saint -Saëns and Paul Dukas) and two mimi/magicians engaged in a suggestive Dombre theater. Finally, Fantasymphony is a limmaginific symphonic program of the Danish National Symphony Orchestra directed by Christian Schumann who - with the subtitle "A concert of magic and fire" - offers a selection of film songs, series and video games that deal with the theme of magic and fantastic. Some examples? The soundtrack of Harry Potter written by John Williams, Lorne Balfe's music for the BBC/HBO His Dark Materials series - These dark subjects, the song Breath of Life of Florence and the Machine for the Biancaneve and the Hunter film, the famous theme of Ramin Djawadi for Game of Thrones or the Music Suite from the series from the series Netflix The Witcher written by Sonya Belousova together with Ticinese Giona Ostinelli. - Livermore Sciò - Magic Music - Sorcelleries for two piano - Fantasymphony - A concert of magic and fire / "Larte magica è quella che ci restituisce il meraviglioso al cuore della vita quotidiana": così si esprimeva lo scrittore Andre Breton e - ringraziando il padre del surrealismo per la citazione e lo spunto - è proprio alla dimensione del magico che si rivolge la puntata di Paganini di domenica 5 ottobre, dalle 10.30 su RSI LA1. Il "Livermore Sciò" - con protagonista Davide Livermore, oggi acclamato regista operistico - è stata una delle produzioni seriali più divertenti e argute del settore musicale RSI. Nellepisodio intitolato "Musica magica" si alternavano, accanto allistrionico padrone di casa, lOrchestra del Teatro Regio di Torino diretta da Carlo Boccadoro, un gruppo di madrigalisti, i musicisti Oliviero Giovannoni e Diego Fasolis. Sorcellerie - letteralmente: stregoneria - è invece un recente spettacolo francese che vede protagonisti il duo di pianiste Jatekok (con opere di Hector Berlioz, Franz Liszt, Camille Saint-Saëns e Paul Dukas) e due mimi/maghi impegnati in un suggestivo teatro dombre. Fantasymphony è infine limmaginifico programma sinfonico della Danish National Symphony Orchestra diretta da Christian Schumann che - con il sottotitolo «un concerto di magia e fuoco» - propone una selezione di brani da film, serie e videogiochi che affrontano il tema del magico e del fantastico. Alcuni esempi? La colonna sonora di Harry Potter scritta da John Williams, le musiche di Lorne Balfe per la serie BBC/HBO His Dark Materials - Queste oscure materie, il brano Breath of Life di Florence and the Machine per il film Biancaneve e il cacciatore, il celebre tema di Ramin Djawadi per Game of Thrones o ancora la Suite musicale dalla serie Netflix The Witcher scritta da Sonya Belousova assieme al ticinese Giona Ostinelli. - Livermore Sciò - Musica magica - Sorcellerie per due pianoforti - Fantasymphony - Un concerto di magia e fuoco

È andato in onda settimanalmente sulla CBS dal 1984 al 1996 e continuò, con diversi TV-movie, fino al 2003 (come Vagone letto con omicidio, La ballata del ragazzo perduto e Appuntamento con la morte). Angela Lansbury ricoprì il ruolo di produttore esecutivo del telefilm nelle sue ultime stagioni. Jessica Fletcher è una perspicace scrittrice di gialli, che si trova spesso a che fare con misteriosi omicidi, per i quali riesce sempre a scoprire il colpevole. Nonostante gran parte del successo de La signora in giallo sia dovuto allo stile e alla finezza interpretativa della sua protagonista, Angela Lansbury non è stata la prima scelta del produttore. programme.desc: It may be the favorite fruit of the Swiss: the apple. Green, red, sugar, acidulus, chewing or cooking, it is degused throughout the year. Les agriculteurs doivent constamment lutter contre les ravageurs et les champignons pour produire des fruits attrayants et beaux. « À bon entendeur » a voulu savoir quels traitements sont necessaires pour obtenir une pomme bio ou une pomme conventionnelle. Reportage et comparaison chez deux producteurs, à Bramois (VS) et à Lully (GE), mardi à 20h10 sur RTS1.

programme.title: Focus / Mise au point
programme.desc: Drone alert: Switzerland is ready?: Mysterious drones who fly over Danish military aeroports and military bases just before a European summit in Copenhagen which carries in particular on an anti-drone wall. Russia is the suspect number and each country whose Switzerland wonders how it would react to an intrusion. Report. Inquire: Cargos sent to India to be in demands: what become of cargo cargoes and cruising boats when they are no longer in the state of navigating? Very few are in demands in Europe, a large part of the fleet leaves for India where they are dismantled by a small hand with small hand in very relative security conditions. ARCHUTURE OF THE FUTURE: Cultivate vertical or under the sea: a hangar close to Zurich, inside the batteries of bins where a part of our aromatic herbs grows. It is called a vertical farm and it embodies the future of agriculture, just as may this underwater structure that cultivate basil near Genes. / Alerte aux drones : la Suisse est-elle prete ?: De mysterieux drones qui survolent des aeroports et des bases militaires danois juste avant un sommet europeen à Copenhague qui porte notamment sur un mur anti-drones. La Russie est le suspect numero et chaque pays dont la Suisse se demande comment il reagirait face à une intrusion. Reportage.Enquete : des cargos envoyes en Inde pour etre demanteles: Que deviennent les cargos et les bateaux de croisière quand ils ne sont plus en etat de naviguer ? Très peu sont demanteles en Europe, une grosse partie de la flotte part pour l’Inde où ils sont demontes par une armee de petites mains bon marche dans des conditions de securite très relatives.Agriculture du futur : cultiver vertical ou sous la mer: Un hangar proche de Zurich, à l’interieur des piles de bacs où pousse desormais une partie de nos herbes aromatiques. On appelle ça une ferme verticale et cela incarne le futur de l’agriculture, tout comme peut-etre cette structure sous-marine qui cultive du basilic près de Genes.

programme.title: A good hear - sign / A bon entendeur - Signe
programme.sub-title: Medicaments with unit: Economy or illusion? - Sign / Medicaments à l’unite : economie ou illusion ? - Signe
programme.desc: The costs of the health explode in Switzerland, our insurance premiums too. Each year, more than 600 million francs in drugs leave in the trash. Attachment often linked to packaging ill -adapted to the treatments prescribed by the doctors. To change the situation, some pharmacists test the distribution of pills to the unit. Is it a real solution to reduce the costs of the health or the powder to the eyes? Another track to avoid this waste would be to have validity dates of longer drugs. Possible or not possible? The point in this emission. / Les coûts de la sante explosent en Suisse, nos primes d’assurance aussi. Chaque annee, plus de 600 millions de francs de medicaments partent à la poubelle. Du gaspillage souvent lie à des emballages mal adaptes aux traitements prescrits par les medecins. Pour changer la donne, certains pharmaciens testent la distribution des pilules à l’unite. Est-ce une vraie solution pour reduire les coûts de la sante ou de la poudre aux yeux ? Une autre piste pour eviter ce gaspillage serait d’avoir des dates de validite des medicaments plus longues. Possible ou pas possible ? Le point dans cette emission.

programme.desc: In Switzerland, we are not going to lie, we like a drink. White, preference. We love white so much that we put it in our national dish: the fondue. He makes us poetic, makes us sing, we celle him in memorable celebrations, and we drink it by speaking political in our cellars or carnotzets. But we do not produce only wine, do you know the history of the absinthe, also called the green fee, which was prohibited and distilleled in secret for years in the Val de Travers? And we have found a family of winegrowers whose grandfather appears in our archives. The Swiss miracle tells you health! / En Suisse, on ne va pas se mentir, on aime boire un coup. De blanc, de preference. On aime tellement le blanc que l’on en met dans notre plat national : la fondue. Il nous rend poetiques, nous fait chanter, on le celèbre dans des fetes memorables, et on le boit en parlant politique dans nos caves ou carnotzets. Mais nous ne produisons pas que du vin, connaissez-vous l’histoire de l’absinthe, egalement appelee la fee verte, qui fut interdite et distillee en secret pendant des annees dans le Val de Travers ? Et nous avons retrouve une famille de vignerons dont le grand-père apparaît dans nos archives. Le Miracle Suisse vous dit sante !

Possible ou pas possible ? Le point dans cette emission.

programme.desc: In this episode, Philippe Gougler travels North Norway. An astonishing journey that leads him to Spitzberg Island where rail history is mainly linked to the exploitation of coal. On this island lost just 1200 km from the North Pole, it will discover the northernmost train in the world, meet the only resident of a ghost city and then accompany a pastor, army of a rifle to protect themselves from bears, to attend an outdoor mass. North Norway is full of sumptuous landscapes. Philippe will join the grandiose decorations of the Lofoten Islands before finding the owner of a train, not like the others, perch on a bridge, which welcomes fishermen from all over the country to fish the most beautiful salmon. An exciting periple during which Philippe Gougler will test his capacity not to stay awake, because in June, in these latitudes, the sun never sets ... / Dans cet episode, Philippe Gougler parcourt la Norvège du Nord. Un voyage etonnant qui le mène sur l’île du Spitzberg où l’histoire ferroviaire est principalement liee à l’exploitation du charbon. Sur cette île perdue à seulement 1200 km du pôle Nord, il va decouvrir le train le plus au nord du monde, rencontrer le seul habitant d’une ville fantôme puis accompagner une Pasteure, armee d’un fusil pour se proteger des ours, pour assister à une messe en plein air. La Norvège du Nord regorge de paysages somptueux. Philippe va rejoindre en train les decors grandioses des îles Lofoten avant de retrouver le proprietaire d’un train, pas comme les autres, perche sur un pont, qui accueille des pecheurs venus de tout le pays pour y pecher les plus beaux saumons. Un periple passionnant pendant lequel Philippe Gougler va tester sa capacite à ne pas rester eveille, car au mois de juin, sous ces latitudes, le soleil ne se couche jamais…

programme.title: Born on October 5, 1950 - Paola Felix / Geboren am 5. Oktober 1950 – Paola Felix
programme.sub-title: October 5, 1950 - Paola Felix / 5. Oktober 1950 - Paola Felix
programme.desc: Born on the same day and in the same year, grew up in the same generation: The «Dok» series «born on…» goes to season third. Origin, fate, talent: The “Dok” series shows how family, social, but also economic developments have worked on tarpaulin and dreams. The singer and entertainer Paola Felix was born on October 5, 1950 in St. Gallen. Her father, the Italian master tailor Vittorio del Medico, has her own in the textile city as a cutting edge. Paola Felix experiences a happily childhood with style. In general, she is something like a chuckling child. As a hit song, she is just as successful as a comofricer of the TV show "Do you understand fun?" On the side of her great love Kurt Felix. It is a picture book career and a picture book marriage until Kurt Felix falls ill and finally dies. In "Born on ..." Paola Felix gives an insight into the high and depths of her biography. Who or what is our life? Catherine Menschenegger was also born on October 5, 1950, in Rome, where the father works at the UN. Family life is not quite as harmonious as with the Del Medico family. The mother educates the daughter with a strict hand. After a hard boarding school and training as a nurse, Catherine Menschenegger draws it away. The old sister of the well-known entrepreneur and FDP politician Filippo Leutenegger lives in Kuwait and Pakistan, travels Halbe Welt as a flight attendant of Swissair and finds her destiny in the humanitarian help. Today she cares for her great passion: the gardener. As a boy, he could only dream of flying: Doriano Dusci was born on October 5, 1950 in Veltlin. His parents both work as defects in Switzerland. Doriano therefore mostly wakes up in his grandparents in Italy. Later, the young Doriano comes to Switzerland with his parents, does an apprenticeship as a mechanic and finds a job as an aircraft mechanic at Swissair. The dream of flying is true for him. At the same time, as an employee, he experiences the two worst events in the history of Swissair: the crash of Swissair 111 in Halifax in 1998 and finally the grounding of the airline. / Geboren am selben Tag und im selben Jahr, aufgewachsen in derselben Generation: Die «DOK»-Serie «Geboren am…» geht in die dritte Staffel. Herkunft, Schicksal, Talent: die «DOK»-Serie zeigt auf, wie familiare, gesellschaftliche, aber auch wirtschaftliche Entwicklungen auf Plane und Traume eingewirkt haben. Die Sangerin und Entertainerin Paola Felix wird am 5. Oktober 1950 in St. Gallen geboren. Ihr Vater, der italienische Schneidermeister Vittorio Del Medico, hat in der Textilstadt ein eigenes Geschaft als Massschneider. Paola Felix erlebt eine gluckliche Kindheit mit Stil. Überhaupt ist sie so etwas wie ein Gluckskind. Als Schlagersangerin ist sie ebenso erfolgreich wie als Komoderatorin der TV-Show «Verstehen Sie Spass?», an der Seite ihrer grossen Liebe Kurt Felix. Es ist eine Bilderbuchkarriere und eine Bilderbuchehe, bis Kurt Felix an Krebs erkrankt und schliesslich stirbt. In «Geboren am…» gibt Paola Felix Einblick in die Hohen und Tiefen ihrer Biografie. Wer oder was pragt unser Leben? Auch Catherine Leutenegger wird am 5. Oktober 1950 geboren, in Rom, wo der Vater bei der UNO arbeitet. Das Familienleben verlauft nicht ganz so harmonisch wie bei Familie Del Medico. Die Mutter erzieht die Tochter mit strenger Hand. Nach einer harten Internatszeit und einer Ausbildung zur Krankenschwester zieht es Catherine Leutenegger in die Ferne. Die altere Schwester des bekannten Unternehmers und FDP-Politikers Filippo Leutenegger lebt in Kuwait und Pakistan, bereist als Flugbegleiterin der Swissair die halbe Welt und findet ihre Bestimmung in der humanitaren Hilfe. Heute pflegt sie ihre grosse Leidenschaft: das Gartnern. Als Bub konnte er von der Fliegerei nur traumen: Doriano Dusci wird am 5. Oktober 1950 im Veltlin geboren. Seine Eltern arbeiten beide als Saisonniers in der Schweiz. Doriano wachst deshalb mehrheitlich bei seinen Grosseltern in Italien auf. Spater kommt der junge Doriano mit den Eltern in die Schweiz, macht eine Lehre als Mechaniker und findet eine Anstellung als Flugzeugmechaniker bei der Swissair. Der Traum vom Fliegen wird fur ihn wahr. Gleichzeitig erlebt er als Mitarbeiter die beiden schlimmsten Ereignisse in der Geschichte der Swissair mit: den Absturz der Swissair 111 in Halifax 1998 und schliesslich das Grounding der Fluggesellschaft.

programme.sub-title: To gast: Anna jewel / Zu Gast: Anna Giacometti

programme.title: Minisguard
programme.desc: In the museum you can admire all sorts of things and even touch: from ancient Rome sword or stone harness, but also newer things like one of the first vacuum cleaners or one of the first milking machines that have existed in Graubunden.Ronja has found the old cell phone of her grandmother and thought: Well, if that doesn't belong to the museum. That is why she brings the cell phone to the Rhatische Museum in Chur Gr. Although she quickly found a place in the exhibition, it is a long way for the old cell phone to really be exhibited. Together with the museum director, Ronja also visits the underground depot, in which the museum kept over 100,000 objects well -used. / Im Museum kann man allerhand Sachen bestaunen und sogar anfassen: vom uralten Romerschwert oder Steingeschirr, aber auch neuere Sachen wie einer der ersten Staubsauger oder eine der ersten Melkmaschinen, die es in Graubunden gegeben hat.Ronja hat das alte Handy ihrer Grossmutter gefunden und sich gedacht: Na, wenn das nicht ins Museum gehort. Deshalb bringt sie das Handy zum Rhatischen Museum in Chur GR. Obwohl sie schnell einen Platz dafur in der Ausstellung gefunden hat, ist es ein langer Weg, bis das alte Handy wirklich ausgestellt werden darf. Zusammen mit dem Museumsdirektor besucht Ronja auch das unterirdische Depot, in dem das Museum uber 100’000 Objekte gut geschutzt aufbewahrt.

programme.title: Cuntrasts
programme.sub-title: Nino Schurter - his last trip / Nino Schurter – Seine letzte Fahrt
programme.desc: Nino Schurter wants to achieve great things in the Mountain Bike World Cup last year. At almost 40, he stands up to everyday hard professional life and is skipping his body-knowing that many opponents are young for up to two decades and wins are less common. The film accompanies the mountain bike legend from the start of the season at the Cape Epic in Sudafrika via the World Cup championships to his very last World Cup start at home in Lenzerheide Gr.schurter gives everything again to explain the dream of home victory. You also experience Nino Schurter privately and learn how he ticks as a person and father and how his environment, his parents, have shaped him. Is Nino Schurter succeeds in a career final point to measure-and how can he let go of this profile life that he lived for around 25 years? / Nino Schurter will in seinem letzten Jahr im Mountainbike-Weltcup noch einmal Grosses erreichen. Mit fast 40 stellt er sich noch einmal dem harten Profi-Alltag, schindet seinen Korper – im Wissen, dass viele Gegner bis zu zwei Jahrzehnte junger sind und Siege seltener werden. Der Film begleitet die Mountainbike-Legende vom Saisonauftakt beim Cape Epic in Sudafrika uber die Weltmeisterschaften im Wallis bis zu seinem allerletzten Weltcup-Start zu Hause in Lenzerheide GR.Schurter gibt nochmals alles, um sich den Traum vom Heimsieg zu erfullen. Dabei erlebt man auch Nino Schurter privat und erfahrt, wie er als Mensch und Vater tickt und wie ihn sein Umfeld, seine Eltern, gepragt haben. Gelingt Nino Schurter ein Karriere-Schlusspunkt nach Mass – und wie kann er dieses Profileben loslassen, das er rund 25 Jahre lang gelebt hat?

programme.title: Free to Run
programme.desc: Whether in the streets of New York or in the Swiss mountains, millions of runners around the world compete in national and international running competitions every year. But in the 1960s, running was an exclusive sport mostly reserved for men. Race was unhealthy, and those who jogged were referred to as a freak. Like a shock wave, the pressing picture of this interaction all over the world draws attention to the situation of women in general and in running in particular, and Kathrine Switzer himself becomes the icon of the struggle for equality of the woman. The director Pierre Morath is raising the incredible story of a bubble marginal sport, which has become a universal passion. A tribute to the freedom of running and to all those who did this. / Ob in den Strassen New Yorks oder in den Schweizer Bergen, jedes Jahr messen sich Millionen von Lauferinnen und Laufern auf der ganzen Welt an nationalen und internationalen Laufwettbewerben. Doch noch in den 1960er-Jahren war das Laufen eine exklusive, zumeist Mannern vorbehaltene Sportart. Rennen war ungesund, und wer joggte, wurde als Freak bezeichnet.Auf Manner, die liefen, zeigte man mit dem Finger, sobald diese die Stadien verliessen und in der Natur rannten. Aber fur die Frauen war die Situation noch viel radikaler: Sie waren von allen Laufen uber 800 Meter ausgeschlossen, da man der Meinung war, dass Frauen korperlich dazu nicht fahig seien und eine rennende Frau einfach nicht schon anzusehen sei. 1967 wird fur die laufenden Frauen hingegen ein entscheidendes Jahr.Kathrine Switzer schreibt sich fur den Boston-Marathon ein und bestreitet diesen illegal. Wahrend des Rennens wird sie als Frau erkannt und der damalige Renndirektor versucht, sie gewaltsam aus dem Lauf zu zerren, was von ihrem Verlobten auf spektakulare Art und Weise verhindert wird. programme.title: SRF Kids – Next Level
programme.sub-title: Mission egg hunt: Which class succeeds in the start? / Mission Eierjagd: Welcher Klasse gelingt der Auftakt?
programme.desc: In the third season of «SRF Kids - Next Level», three primary classes from the cantons of Obwalden, Nidwalden and Lucerne give everything to dust off the large trophy and main prize: The schoolmen from Sachseln OW, Dallenwil NW and Lucerne would definitely like to take nights in the Zoo - in a yurt and experience what the animals in Drive night. But until then they have to master six levels and lots of challenges. In the first episode, it becomes tricky, because the Challenge «Ruhr-Ei» not only requires teamwork, but also skill: Equipped with an loft in the mouth, an egg is to hike from child to child until it is catapulted in a nest in a nest in a nest. If the egg ends up on the floor and breaks, the fun begins from the front. In the second challenge of the first episode, it is important to conquer the "flying carpet". The kids have to complete a course without watching the ground, because that costs penalty seconds. Every second pays here, and the teams give everything to glide through the finish at lightning speed. Who keeps the nerves and can make it the fastest - the class from Sachseln ow, Dallenwil NW or Lucerne? If the first two challenges have been achieved, there is already the next challenge: at the “nasty quiz” particularly common questions await the teams. / Bei der dritten Staffel von «SRF Kids – Next Level» geben drei Primarklassen aus den Kantonen Obwalden, Nidwalden und Luzern alles, um den grossen Pokal und Hauptpreis abzustauben: Die Schulerinnen und Schuler aus Sachseln OW, Dallenwil NW und Luzern mochten unbedingt im Zoo Zurich Nachtwandeln – also in einer Jurte ubernachten und erleben, was die Tiere in der Nacht treiben. Doch bis dahin mussen sie erst einmal sechs Level und jede Menge Challenges meistern.Schon in der ersten Folge wird es knifflig, denn die Challenge «Ruhr-Ei» verlangt nicht nur Teamwork, sondern auch Geschicklichkeit: Ausgestattet mit einem Loffel im Mund soll ein Ei von Kind zu Kind wandern, bis es mittels Bungee-Trampolin in ein Nest in luftiger Hohe katapultiert wird. Landet das Ei unsanft auf dem Boden und geht zu Bruch, beginnt der Spass von vorne.In der zweiten Challenge der ersten Folge gilt es, den «Fliegenden Teppich» zu bezwingen. Die Kids mussen einen Parcours absolvieren, ohne den Boden zu beruhren, denn das kostet Strafsekunden. Hier zahlt jede Sekunde, und die Teams geben alles, um blitzschnell durchs Ziel zu gleiten. Wer behalt die Nerven und schafft es am schnellsten – die Klasse aus Sachseln OW, Dallenwil NW oder Luzern?Sind die ersten beiden Challenges geschafft, gibt es schon die nachste Herausforderung: Beim «Fiesen Quiz» warten besonders gemeine Fragen auf die Teams.

programme.title: Immenhof - the big promise / Immenhof – Das grosse Versprechen

programme.title: The world's most splendid train - on the way with the Shinkansen / Der punktlichste Zug der Welt – Unterwegs mit dem Shinkansen
programme.sub-title: From Osaka in the Suden Japan / Von Osaka in den Suden Japans
programme.desc: Japans Shinkansen ist der punktlichste Langstrecken-Express der Welt. Der Hokuriku-Shinkansen bringt seine Gaste von der Glitzermetropole Tokio nach Kanazawa, mitten ins Herz des japanischen Traditionshandwerks. Die Reise fuhrt vorbei an einigen der schonsten und ursprunglichsten Orte Japans.

programme.title: Meilensteine der Technik
programme.desc: Die Reihe «Great Inventions – Meilensteine der Technik» gewahrt Einblicke in die Entstehung und Funktionsweise bahnbrechender Erfindungen, die aus dem Alltag heute nicht mehr wegzudenken sind.Strom, Trinkwasser, Schutz: Kunstliche Staudamme erfullen viele lebenswichtige Zwecke. Die Geschichte von gestautem Wasser ist fast so alt wie die Menschheit selbst, in heutigen Staudammen stecken die Techniken grosser Kulturen: der Ägypter, der Romer, der Griechen. Aber bereits in der Jungsteinzeit manipulierten Menschen Wasserlaufe, um ihre Felder leichter bewassern zu konnen. In der modernen Gesellschaft mit ihrem unersattlichen Bedarf an Energie wachst die Bedeutung der Staudamme mit ihren Turbinen zur Stromerzeugung. Riesige Stauseen sind aber auch der Grund fur einige der weitreichendsten Umsiedlungsaktionen der Geschichte. Die Dokumentation berichtet uber kontrollierte Bewasserung, versunkene Stadte und Wasserkraft als nachhaltige Energiequelle.

Tochter Verena ist gepragt vom beschwerlichen Leben ihrer Eltern und macht sich auf, den negativen Kreislauf zu durchbrechen.

programme.title: Sportpanorama
programme.sub-title: Studiogast - Fabian wheels, footballs / Studiogast – Fabian Rieder, Fussballer
programme.desc: Fabian Rieder: In top form in the World Cup qualification? With two wins and seven goals against Kosovo and Slovenia, the Swiss national team was perfectly successful in the World Cup qualification. One of the most noticeable Swiss: Fabian Rieder. The 23-year-old delivered a template in both games and thus had its share in the two clear victories. Before the next tranche in the qualification for the World Cup in the USA, Canada and Mexico, Rieder visits the "Sports Panorama" on Sunday, October 5, 2025 and, in addition to the upcoming duels with Sweden and Slovenia, also speaks about his summer transfer to FC Augsburg.Basketball: Silberhelden between the Frontenan The 3x3 basketball World Championship in Mongolia Switzerland won the silver medal in June. Surprisingly, because so far only one of the Swiss quartet is full of 3x3 basketball. At Natan Jurkovitz and Jonathan Kazadi, the main focus as a player of Friborg Olympic is still on the 5x5 basketball. Logistically a challenge because the seasons of the two formats partially overlap. From the next season, the Swiss World Cup medalists want to concentrate fully on 3x3 basketball and pursue the plan of their own team in Freiburg. With regard to the 2028 Olympic Games in Los Angeles, an important decision, since it is then about points for the Olympic qualification. Football: How technology had a world sport after football has long been traditionally on the road, the technologization in the largest sport in the world has developed rapidly. Performance data from players are recorded, the goal line technology moved in and the VAR was introduced. While aids such as the goal line technology are undisputed and popular, other innovations are often carried out by violent debates. IIRMAN: When footballers learn from extreme athletes120 Ironmans in 120 days - which sounds like a thing of impossibility, he succeeded: Jonas Deichmann. What drives a person to such a performance, and what teachers did the German extreme athlete draw from these experiences? The 38-year-old is now a lecture and is also guesting at FC St. Gallen. “Sports panorama” is there. / Fabian Rieder: In Top-Form in die WM-Qualifikation?Mit zwei Siegen und sieben Toren gegen den Kosovo und Slowenien ist dem Schweizer Nationalteam der Auftakt in die WM-Qualifikation perfekt gelungen. Einer der auffalligsten Schweizer: Fabian Rieder. Der 23-Jahrige lieferte in beiden Spielen jeweils eine Vorlage und hatte so seinen Anteil an den beiden klaren Siegen. Bevor die nachste Tranche in der Qualifikation fur die Weltmeisterschaft in den USA, Kanada und Mexiko ansteht, besucht Rieder am Sonntag, 5. Oktober 2025, das «Sportpanorama» und spricht neben den anstehenden Duellen mit Schweden und Slowenien auch uber seinen Sommer-Transfer zum FC Augsburg.Basketball: Silberhelden zwischen den FrontenAn der 3x3-Basketball-WM in der Mongolei gewann die Schweiz im Juni uberraschend die Silbermedaille. Überraschend, weil sich bis dato nur einer des Schweizer Quartetts voll dem 3x3-Basketball verschrieben hat. Bei Natan Jurkovitz und Jonathan Kazadi liegt der Hauptfokus als Spieler von Fribourg Olympic weiterhin auf dem 5x5-Basketball. Logistisch eine Herausforderung, da die Saisons der beiden Formate teilweise uberlappen. Ab nachster Saison wollen sich die Schweizer WM-Medaillengewinner voll aufs 3x3-Basketball konzentrieren und verfolgen den Plan eines eigenen Teams in Freiburg. Im Hinblick auf die Olympischen Spiele 2028 in Los Angeles ein wichtiger Entscheid, da es ab dann um Punkte fur die Olympia-Qualifikation geht.Fussball: Wie Technologie einen Weltsport einnimmtNachdem der Fussball lange traditionell unterwegs war, hat sich die Technologisierung in der grossten Sportart der Welt rasant entwickelt. Leistungsdaten von Spielerinnen und Spielern werden erfasst, die Torlinientechnik hielt Einzug und der VAR wurde eingefuhrt. Wahrend Hilfsmittel wie die Torlinientechnologie unumstritten und popular sind, werden um andere Neuerungen des Öfteren heftige Debatten gefuhrt.Ironman: Wenn Fussballer von Extremsportlern lernen120 Ironmans in 120 Tagen – Was nach einem Ding der Unmoglichkeit klingt, ist ihm gelungen: Jonas Deichmann. Was treibt einen Menschen zu einer solchen Leistung, und welche Lehren hat der deutsche Extremsportler aus diesen Erfahrungen gezogen? Daruber halt der 38-Jahrige jetzt Vortrage und gastiert damit auch beim FC St. Gallen. «Sportpanorama» ist dabei.

programme.title: Tagesschau 20 years ago / Tagesschau vor 20 Jahren
programme.desc: The “Tagesschau” of Swiss television has been providing the news look since 1953. Over the years, the program has been adapted again and again - to the technological developments, but above all to the necessary things of the audience. The aim is to bring the most important topics at home and abroad every evening. Which domestic debates and international conflicts prompted the reporting at the time - and which of them are still doing it today? The view of the archive offers the possibility of climbing, classifying and remembering. / Die «Tagesschau» des Schweizer Fernsehens liefert seit 1953 allabendlich den Nachrichtenuberblick. Im Laufe der Jahre wurde die Sendung immer wieder angepasst – an die technologischen Entwicklungen, vor allem aber an die Bedurfnisse des Publikums. Gleich geblieben ist der Anspruch, jeden Abend die wichtigsten Themen im In- und Ausland kurz und verstandlich aufzubereiten.Die «Tagesschau vor 20 Jahren» bietet einen Nachrichtenruckblick in die jungere Geschichte: Welche Themen bewegten heute vor exakt 20 Jahren? Welche innenpolitischen Debatten und internationalen Konflikte pragten damals die Berichterstattung – und welche davon tun es bis heute? Der Blick ins Archiv bietet die Moglichkeit zum Anknupfen, Einordnen und Erinnern.

programme.title: SRF bi de Lut
programme.sub-title: Karin Hengartner, Olten like this / Karin Hengartner, Olten SO
programme.desc: Seven farmers from seven regions cook for the bet. And each has only one goal: to conjure up the best dish from their regional specialists. "SRF Bi de Lut - Landfrauenkuche" shows the farmers while cooking and accompanies them for a week through their everyday life with their families. The focus is on Karin Hengartner from the canton of Solothurn. / Sieben Bauerinnen aus sieben Regionen kochen um die Wette. Und jede hat nur ein Ziel: Das beste Gericht aus ihren regionaltypischen Spezialitaten herbeizuzaubern. «SRF bi de Lut – Landfrauenkuche» zeigt die Bauerinnen beim Kochen und begleitet sie eine Woche lang durch ihren Alltag mit ihren Familien. In der funften Folge steht Karin Hengartner aus dem Kanton Solothurn im Fokus.

programme.title: Helvetia
programme.sub-title: Traumas in Estonia, live in Switzerland: rapper stress Ubers grow up, opportunities and challenges / Traumen in Estland, Leben in der Schweiz: Rapper Stress ubers Aufwachsen, Chancen and Herausforderungen
programme.desc: How does one of the place you grew up? What does "home" mean - and how do you feel connected to Switzerland when you have other cultural backgrounds? "Helvetia" follows these questions and, together with the protagonists, examines their identity and what influenced them in their biographies. / Wie pragt einen der Ort, an dem man aufgewachsen ist? Was bedeutet «Heimat» – und wie fuhlt man sich selbst mit der Schweiz verbunden, wenn man andere kulturelle Hintergrunde hat? Diesen Fragen geht «Helvetia» nach und untersucht gemeinsam mit den Protagonistinnen und Protagonisten ihre Identitat und was sie in ihren Biografien beeinflusst hat.

programme.title: Zauberhaftes Tessin - Giornico und Chironico
programme.desc: Documentary films by «Play Suisse», which open a window to the other language regions of Switzerland - in original language with German subtitles. They are stories about life and the people in Ticino, in western Switzerland and Rator -Romanesque Switzerland: as diverse as the country. / Dokumentarfilme von «Play Suisse», die ein Fenster in die anderen Sprachregionen der Schweiz offnen – in Originalsprache mit deutschen Untertiteln. Es sind Geschichten uber das Leben und die Menschen im Tessin, in der Westschweiz und der ratoromanischen Schweiz: so vielfaltig wie das Land.

programme.title: Die Damer der Belle Époque / Die Damen der Belle Époque
programme.desc: These boats with their chic salons remind us of the elegant women of the Belle Époque. They have been plowing the Swiss water for over a century and are more than simple means of transport - they are real relics of the national cultural asset. / Diese Boote mit ihren schicken Salons erinnern uns an die eleganten Damen der Belle Époque. Seit uber einem Jahrhundert durchpflugen sie die Schweizer Gewasser und sind mehr als einfache Transportmittel - sie sind echte Relikte des nationalen Kulturguts.

programme.desc: In the third season of «SRF Kids - Next Level», three primary classes from the cantons of Obwalden, Nidwalden and Lucerne give everything to dust off the large trophy and main prize: The schoolmen from Sachseln OW, Dallenwil NW and Lucerne would definitely like to take nights in the Zoo - in a yurt and experience what the animals in Drive night. But until then they have to master six levels and lots of challenges. In the first episode, it becomes tricky, because the Challenge «Ruhr-Ei» not only requires teamwork, but also skill: Equipped with an loft in the mouth, an egg is to hike from child to child until it is catapulted in a nest in a nest in a nest. If the egg ends up on the floor and breaks, the fun begins from the front. In the second challenge of the first episode, it is important to conquer the "flying carpet". The kids have to complete a course without watching the ground, because that costs penalty seconds. Every second pays here, and the teams give everything to glide through the finish at lightning speed. Who keeps the nerves and can make it the fastest - the class from Sachseln ow, Dallenwil NW or Lucerne? If the first two challenges have been achieved, there is already the next challenge: at the “nasty quiz” particularly common questions await the teams. / Bei der dritten Staffel von «SRF Kids – Next Level» geben drei Primarklassen aus den Kantonen Obwalden, Nidwalden und Luzern alles, um den grossen Pokal und Hauptpreis abzustauben: Die Schulerinnen und Schuler aus Sachseln OW, Dallenwil NW und Luzern mochten unbedingt im Zoo Zurich Nachtwandeln – also in einer Jurte ubernachten und erleben, was die Tiere in der Nacht treiben. Doch bis dahin mussen sie erst einmal sechs Level und jede Menge Challenges meistern.Schon in der ersten Folge wird es knifflig, denn die Challenge «Ruhr-Ei» verlangt nicht nur Teamwork, sondern auch Geschicklichkeit: Ausgestattet mit einem Loffel im Mund soll ein Ei von Kind zu Kind wandern, bis es mittels Bungee-Trampolin in ein Nest in luftiger Hohe katapultiert wird. Landet das Ei unsanft auf dem Boden und geht zu Bruch, beginnt der Spass von vorne.In der zweiten Challenge der ersten Folge gilt es, den «Fliegenden Teppich» zu bezwingen. Die Kids mussen einen Parcours absolvieren, ohne den Boden zu beruhren, denn das kostet Strafsekunden. Hier zahlt jede Sekunde, und die Teams geben alles, um blitzschnell durchs Ziel zu gleiten. Wer behalt die Nerven und schafft es am schnellsten – die Klasse aus Sachseln OW, Dallenwil NW oder Luzern?Sind die ersten beiden Challenges geschafft, gibt es schon die nachste Herausforderung: Beim «Fiesen Quiz» warten besonders gemeine Fragen auf die Teams.

programme.title: rec.

programme.title: Bob Ballard - the life of a discoverer / Bob Ballard - Das Leben eines Entdeckers
programme.desc: Robert “Bob” Ballard is probably the most reduced underwater archaologist in the world: the geophysicist became known primarily through the discovery of the wreck of the “Titanic” and the German battleship “Bismarck” in 1941. The location of one of the oldest known wreck, a phonizian ship from the 7th century BC, is also thanks to his work. For the documentation, Ballard reviews the most important stations of his scientific career, reports on his triumphs, but also of jerking and personal support. / Robert “Bob“ Ballard ist der wahrscheinlich beruhmteste Unterwasser-Archaologe der Welt: Bekannt wurde der Geophysiker vor allem durch die Entdeckung des Wracks der “Titanic“ sowie des 1941 von der Royal Navy versenkten deutschen Schlachtschiffs “Bismarck“. Auch die Ortung eines der altesten bekannten Wracks, eines phonizischen Schiffs aus dem 7. Jahrhundert vor Christus, ist seiner Arbeit zu verdanken. Fur die Dokumentation lasst Ballard die wichtigsten Stationen seiner wissenschaftlichen Karriere Revue passieren, berichtet von seinen Triumphen, aber auch von Ruckschlagen und personlichen Tragodien.

programme.title: The Tunnel
programme.desc: A few years have passed since her mother's death. But Elise is still not ready to spend Christmas with her father. She decides on a bus that is supposed to bring her to relatives.
